use GE2021.shared.prog

spec gIdealIQFTRead:
  ∀α .
    requires  0 < nA  ∧  0 < wExp
              ∧  expWire + (m + 1)*wExp ≤ dim
    assumes   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z) * |z⟩_q[0, dim) }}
    ensures   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . (Σ y < 2^wExp .
                 (α(z) * ((1/sqrt(2^wExp))
                   * ω(-rev(getReg(z, expWire + m*wExp, wExp), wExp)
                        * (getReg(z, expWire + (m*wExp//nA)*nA, ladderLen(wExp, nA, m, 0))
                           + 2^ladderLen(wExp, nA, m, 0)*y),
                       2^(ladderLen(wExp, nA, m, 0) + wExp))))
                 * |setReg(z, expWire + (m*wExp//nA)*nA, ladderLen(wExp, nA, m, 0) + wExp,
                           getReg(z, expWire + (m*wExp//nA)*nA, ladderLen(wExp, nA, m, 0))
                             + 2^ladderLen(wExp, nA, m, 0)*y)⟩_q[0, dim)) }}
    outcomes  none
    resource  { toffoli: 0,
                t: tIdealRead(wExp, nA, m),
                clifford: cliffIdealRead(wExp, nA, m),
                rot: rotIdealRead(wExp, nA, m),
                meas: 0 }

spec gIdealIQFT:
  ∀α .
  requires  0 < nA  ∧  0 < nE - nA  ∧  nE - nA ≤ nA
            ∧  expWire + nE ≤ dim
  assumes   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z) * |z⟩_q[0, dim) }}
  ensures   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . (Σ v < 2^nE .
                 (α(z) * ((1/sqrt(2^nE))
                   * (ω(-rev(getReg(z, expWire, nA), nA)*(v%2^nA), 2^nA)
                      * ω(-rev(getReg(z, expWire + nA, nE - nA), nE - nA)*(v//2^nA),
                          2^(nE - nA)))))
                 * |setReg(z, expWire, nE, v)⟩_q[0, dim)) }}
  outcomes  none
  resource  { toffoli: 0,
              t: (Σ p < nE . tIdealRead(1, nA, p)),
              clifford: (Σ p < nE . cliffIdealRead(1, nA, p)),
              rot: (Σ p < nE . rotIdealRead(1, nA, p)),
              meas: 0,
              qubits: nE }

params  bits, cm, N, Ninv, pBase, wBase, outBase, addBase
params  wExp, wMul, W, w, gSep, pieceLen, addrZone, expWire
params  numMults, numWin, numWinMul, tSize, ctrl, cb, nA
params  ehM, ehL, ehD, ehA, ehR0, ehB
params  g, gInv
params  recSlots

arrays  T, Tbar

amps    α

map id()(i) = i


define bit(e, k)           = (e >> k) % 2
define popCount(x, n) = Σ i < n . bit(x, i)

define ceilDiv(x, y) = (x + y - 1)//y

define pieceCount(bits, gSep) = ceilDiv(bits, gSep)

define regWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen) = pieceCount(bits, gSep)*(pieceLen + 1)

define outWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen) = pieceCount(bits, gSep)*(pieceLen + 1)

define halfLo(w) = w//2

define halfHi(w) = w - w//2

define zoneStride(wExp, wMul) = 2*(wExp + wMul) + 2^halfLo(wExp + wMul) + 2^halfHi(wExp + wMul)


define posWire(posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride, i) = posBase + segStride*(i//segLen) + posStride*(i%segLen)
define posGet(n, z, posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride) = Σ i < n . bit(z, posWire(posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride, i))*2^i
define posXor(0, z, posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride, v) = z
define posXor(n+1, z, posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride, v) = xorBitAt(posXor(n, z, posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride, v), posWire(posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride, n), bit(v, n))
define posSet(n, z, posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride, v) = posXor(n, z, posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride, posGet(n, z, posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride) ⊕ v)

define copySrc(w, yBase, j, i) = yBase + j*w + i

define copyTgt(addrBase, i) = addrBase + i

define xorLow(0, x, y)   = 0
define xorLow(k+1, x, y) = xorLow(k, x, y) + 2^k * (bit(x, k) ⊕ bit(y, k))

define xorBitAt(x, p, v) = x%2^p + 2^p*(bit(x, p) ⊕ v) + 2^(p+1)*(x >> (p+1))

define getReg(z, base, n) = (z >> base)%2^n
define setReg(z, base, n, v) = z%2^base + 2^base*(v%2^n) + 2^(base + n)*(z >> (base + n))
define majWord(z, a, b, cin) = xorBitAt(xorBitAt(xorBitAt(z, b, bit(z, cin)), a, bit(z, cin)), cin, (bit(z, a) ⊕ bit(z, cin))*(bit(z, b) ⊕ bit(z, cin)))
define umaWord(z, a, b, cin) = xorBitAt(xorBitAt(xorBitAt(z, a, bit(z, cin) ⊕ (bit(z, a)*bit(z, b))), b, bit(z, a) ⊕ (bit(z, cin) ⊕ (bit(z, a)*bit(z, b)))), cin, bit(z, a)*bit(z, b))

define copyWindow(0, f, w, yBase, j, addrBase)   = f
define copyWindow(n+1, f, w, yBase, j, addrBase) = xorBitAt(copyWindow(n, f, w, yBase, j, addrBase), copyTgt(addrBase, n), bit(f, copySrc(w, yBase, j, n)))

define ppSpec(k, a, S) = Π j < k . (1 - bit(S, j) + bit(S, j)*bit(a, j))
define ppWord(k, a) = Σ S < 2^k . ppSpec(k, a, S)*2^S

define rev(x, n) = Σ i < n . bit(x, i)*2^(n - 1 - i)

define geE1Word(wExp, nA, m, e) = Σ i < wExp . (if m*wExp + i < nA then bit(e, i)*2^(nA - 1 - (m*wExp + i)) else 0)

define geE2Word(wExp, nA, nE, m, e) = Σ i < wExp . (if m*wExp + i < nA then 0 else (if m*wExp + i < nE then bit(e, i)*2^(nE - 1 - (m*wExp + i)) else 0))

define ehOffsetExp(N, m) = (N - 1)//2 - 2^m

define geFactor(N, g, gInv, wExp, nA, nE, m, e) = (g^geE1Word(wExp, nA, m, e)*gInv^(ehOffsetExp(N, 2*nA - nE)*geE2Word(wExp, nA, nE, m, e)))%N

define vwWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen) = (pieceCount(bits, gSep) - 1)*(gSep + 1) + pieceLen

define vwWeight(bits, gSep, pieceLen, v) = if v < (pieceCount(bits, gSep) - 1)*gSep + pieceLen then v else (v - (pieceCount(bits, gSep) - 1)*gSep - pieceLen)*gSep + pieceLen

define vwPos(bits, gSep, pieceLen, R, v) = if v < (pieceCount(bits, gSep) - 1)*gSep then R + (v//gSep)*pieceLen + v%gSep else (if v < (pieceCount(bits, gSep) - 1)*gSep + pieceLen then R + (pieceCount(bits, gSep) - 1)*pieceLen + v - (pieceCount(bits, gSep) - 1)*gSep else R + pieceCount(bits, gSep)*pieceLen + (v - (pieceCount(bits, gSep) - 1)*gSep - pieceLen))

define vwWindow(bits, gSep, pieceLen, R, wMul, k, z) = Σ i < wMul . (if k*wMul + i < vwWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen) then bit(z, vwPos(bits, gSep, pieceLen, R, k*wMul + i)) else 0)*2^i

define geSourceWindow(bits, gSep, pieceLen, wMul, k, y) = Σ i < wMul . (if k*wMul + i < vwWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen) then bit(y, i)*2^vwWeight(bits, gSep, pieceLen, k*wMul + i) else 0)

define geTableValue(bits, N, g, gInv, wExp, wMul, gSep, pieceLen, nA, nE, m, pass, k, a) = ((if pass = 0 then geFactor(N, g, gInv, wExp, nA, nE, m, a%2^wExp) else N - geFactor(N, gInv, g, wExp, nA, nE, m, a%2^wExp))*geSourceWindow(bits, gSep, pieceLen, wMul, k, a//2^wExp))%N

define gePhaseCoeff(w, tOff, i, s) = (Σ a < 2^w . bit(T[tOff + a], i)*ppSpec(w, s, a))%2

define gePhaseWord(w, tOff, i, lo) = Σ hi < 2^halfHi(w) . gePhaseCoeff(w, tOff, i, lo + 2^halfLo(w)*hi)*2^hi

define runwayLookupAdd(bits, gSep, pieceLen, x, y) = Σ p < pieceCount(bits, gSep) . (((x//2^(p*pieceLen))%2^pieceLen + (y//2^(p*gSep))%2^gSep)%2^pieceLen)*2^(p*pieceLen)

define bmodAbs(u, n) = if u%n < (n + 1)//2 then u%n else n - u%n


define ehRecoverable(m, l, d, A, r, j, k) = bmodAbs(d*j + 2^m*k, 2^(l + m)) < A  ∧  (∀ a < r . a = 0 ∨ r ≤ bmodAbs(a*j, 2^(l + m)))

define ehTail(m, l, A, r) = 41/100*(2^(2*m)/A^2 + 2^m/A) + (2^(2*m)/2^(2*(l + m - 5)) + 2^m/2^(l + m - 5)) + 15*r^2/2^(l + m)

define ehRootEq(p, d, N) = p*p + N = d*p

define ehFactorHigh(d, N) = (d + isqrt(d*d - 4*N))//2

define ehFactorLow(d, N) = (d - isqrt(d*d - 4*N))//2

define ehSum(d, m) = 2*(d + 2^m + 1)

define toffRelocAdder(n) = 2*n

define cliffRelocAdder(n) = 4*n

define toffRunwayAdd(bits, gSep, pieceLen) = pieceCount(bits, gSep)*toffRelocAdder(pieceLen)

define cliffRunwayAdd(bits, gSep, pieceLen) = pieceCount(bits, gSep)*cliffRelocAdder(pieceLen)

define toffQROM(d) = 2^d - 1

define measQROM(d) = 2^d - 1

define cliffQROM(d, W, base, tOff) = 7*(2^d - 1) + (Σ a < 2^d . (Σ j < W . bit(T[tOff + base + a], j)))

define toffPP(k) = 2^k - k - 1

define cliffPP(k) = k + 1

define cliffPPRelease(k) = 5*toffPP(k) + k + 1

define measPPRelease(k) = toffPP(k)

define toffPhaseup(w) = toffPP(halfLo(w)) + toffPP(halfHi(w))

define phaseBits(W, kL, kH, ppLow, ppHigh, tOff, z) = Σ i < W . (maskedPhase(kL, kH, ppLow, ppHigh, tOff*(W*2^kL) + i*2^kL, z)%2)*2^i
define maskedPhase(kL, kH, ppLow, ppHigh, tOff, z) = Σ mL < 2^kL . (Σ mH < 2^kH . bit(Tbar[tOff + mL], mH)*bit(z, ppLow + mL)*bit(z, ppHigh + mH))

define czUnlookup(W, w, tOff) = 2^halfLo(w)*2^halfHi(w)
define parityPhase(W, kL, kH, ppLow, ppHigh, tOff, r, z) = Σ i < W . bit(r, i)*maskedPhase(kL, kH, ppLow, ppHigh, tOff*(W*2^kL) + i*2^kL, z)

define cliffUnlookup(W, w, tOff) = 2*W + cliffPP(halfLo(w)) + cliffPP(halfHi(w)) + cliffPPRelease(halfLo(w)) + cliffPPRelease(halfHi(w)) + 3*czUnlookup(W, w, tOff)

define measUnlookup(W, w) = W + measPPRelease(halfLo(w)) + measPPRelease(halfHi(w))

define toffLookupAdd(w, bits, gSep, pieceLen) = toffQROM(w) + toffRunwayAdd(bits, gSep, pieceLen) + toffPhaseup(w)

define cliffLookupAdd(w, W, bits, gSep, pieceLen, tOff) = cliffQROM(w, W, 0, tOff) + cliffRunwayAdd(bits, gSep, pieceLen) + cliffUnlookup(W, w, tOff)

define measLookupAdd(w, W) = measQROM(w) + measUnlookup(W, w)

define toffFoldPair(bits, gSep, pieceLen) = 2*(pieceCount(bits, gSep) - 1)*toffRelocAdder(pieceLen - gSep + 1)

define cliffFoldPair(bits, gSep, pieceLen) = (pieceCount(bits, gSep) - 1)*(14*(pieceLen - gSep) + 22)

define toffLaChain(wExp, wMul, bits, gSep, pieceLen, numMults, numWinMul) = 2*numMults*(numWinMul*toffLookupAdd(wExp + wMul, bits, gSep, pieceLen) + toffFoldPair(bits, gSep, pieceLen))

define measLaChain(wExp, wMul, W, numMults, numWinMul) = 2*numMults*numWinMul*measLookupAdd(wExp + wMul, W)

define cliffLaChain(wExp, wMul, W, bits, gSep, pieceLen, numMults, numWinMul, tSize) = Σ m < numMults . (Σ p < 2 . (cliffFoldPair(bits, gSep, pieceLen) + (Σ k < numWinMul . (2*wExp + 2*min(wMul, vwWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen) - k*wMul) + cliffLookupAdd(wExp + wMul, W, bits, gSep, pieceLen, ((2*m + p)*numWinMul + k)*tSize)))))

define toffMulAccConst(bits) = bits*toffRelocAdder(bits)

define toffMulInPlace(bits) = 2*toffMulAccConst(bits)

define toffMulAccConstLow(bits, low) = low*toffRelocAdder(bits)

define toffMulFromLow(bits, low) = toffMulAccConstLow(bits, low) + toffMulAccConst(bits)

define toffCosetPrep(bits, cm) = toffMulFromLow(bits, cm) + toffRelocAdder(bits)

define cliffCtrlAddConst(bits, cst) = 2*popCount(cst, bits) + cliffRelocAdder(bits)

define cliffMulAccConst(bits, cst) = Σ i < bits . cliffCtrlAddConst(bits, (cst*2^i)%2^bits)

define cliffMulInPlace(bits, cst, cstInv) = cliffMulAccConst(bits, cst) + 3*bits + cliffMulAccConst(bits, (2^bits - cstInv)%2^bits)

define cliffMulAccConstLow(bits, cst, low) = Σ i < low . cliffCtrlAddConst(bits, (cst*2^i)%2^bits)

define cliffMulFromLow(bits, cst, cstInv, low) = cliffMulAccConstLow(bits, cst, low) + 3*bits + cliffMulAccConst(bits, (2^bits - cstInv)%2^bits)

define cliffAddConstInto(bits, cst) = 2*popCount(cst, bits) + cliffRelocAdder(bits)

define cliffCosetPrep(bits, cm, N, Ninv, k) = cm + cliffMulFromLow(bits, N, Ninv, cm) + cliffAddConstInto(bits, k)

define toffInsertRunways(bits, cm, gSep) = Σ p < pieceCount(bits, gSep) - 1 . toffRelocAdder((pieceCount(bits, gSep) - p - 1)*gSep + cm)

define cliffInsertRunways(bits, cm, gSep) = Σ p < pieceCount(bits, gSep) - 1 . (9*((pieceCount(bits, gSep) - p - 1)*gSep + cm) + 3*cm)

define toffPrepRunways(bits, cm, gSep) = toffCosetPrep(bits + cm, cm) + toffInsertRunways(bits, cm, gSep)

define cliffPrepRunways(bits, cm, gSep, N, Ninv, k) = cliffCosetPrep(bits + cm, cm, N, Ninv, k) + cliffInsertRunways(bits, cm, gSep)

define ladderLen(wExp, nA, m, i) = m*wExp + i - (m*wExp//nA)*nA

define tIdealRead(wExp, nA, m) = 2*(Σ i < wExp . min(ladderLen(wExp, nA, m, i), 1))

define rotIdealRead(wExp, nA, m) = 2*(Σ i < wExp . max(ladderLen(wExp, nA, m, i) - 1, 0))

define cliffIdealRead(wExp, nA, m) = wExp + 2*(Σ i < wExp . ladderLen(wExp, nA, m, i))

define ge2021Layout(bits, cm, pBase, wBase, outBase, addBase, addrZone, expWire, ctrl, gSep, pieceLen, wExp, wMul, numMults) = pBase + regWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen) ≤ wBase ∧ wBase + regWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen) ≤ outBase ∧ outBase + outWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen) ≤ addrZone ∧ addrZone + zoneStride(wExp, wMul) ≤ expWire ∧ expWire + numMults*wExp ≤ ctrl ∧ outBase + bits + cm ≤ addBase ∧ addBase + bits + cm + 1 ≤ ctrl ∧ ctrl < dim

define geAdderCarry(k, x, y) = ((x%2^k) + (y%2^k))//2^k
define geAdderMiddle(n, x, y) = Σ j < n . (geAdderCarry(j+1, x, y) ⊕ bit(y, j+1))*2^j
define majChainWord(n, accBase, addBase, z) = setReg(setReg(setReg(z, accBase, n, getReg(z, accBase, n) ⊕ getReg(z, addBase, n)), addBase, n, geAdderMiddle(n, getReg(z, accBase, n), getReg(z, addBase, n))), addBase + n, 1, bit(getReg(z, addBase, n), 0))
define addWord(n, accBase, addBase, z) = setReg(z, accBase, n, getReg(z, accBase, n) + getReg(z, addBase, n))
define xorReg(z, base, n, v) = setReg(z, base, n, getReg(z, base, n) ⊕ v)
define addConstWord(bits, cst, accBase, z) = setReg(z, accBase, bits, getReg(z, accBase, bits) + cst)
define getRegS(z, base, stride, n) = Σ i < n . bit(z, base + stride*i)*2^i
define xorRegS(z, base, stride, n, v) = z ⊕ Σ i < n . bit(v, i)*2^(base + stride*i)
define setRegS(z, base, stride, n, v) = xorRegS(z, base, stride, n, getRegS(z, base, stride, n) ⊕ v)
define swapRegS(z, aBase, aStride, yBase, yStride, n) = xorRegS(xorRegS(z, aBase, aStride, n, getRegS(z, aBase, aStride, n) ⊕ getRegS(z, yBase, yStride, n)), yBase, yStride, n, getRegS(z, aBase, aStride, n) ⊕ getRegS(z, yBase, yStride, n))
define mulPrepWord(bits, low, regBase, accBase, addBase, z) = setReg(setReg(setReg(z, regBase, bits, getReg(z, regBase, low)), accBase, bits, 0), addBase, bits + 1, 0)
define prepZeroWord(bits, regBase, accBase, addBase, z) = setReg(setReg(setReg(z, regBase, bits, 0), accBase, bits, 0), addBase, bits + 1, 0)
define runwayClearWord(bits, gSep, pieceLen, outBase, z) = setRegS(z, outBase + pieceLen, pieceLen + 1, pieceCount(bits, gSep), 0)
define runwaySumWord(bits, gSep, pieceLen, runBase, outBase, z) = setReg(z, runBase, pieceCount(bits, gSep)*pieceLen, Σ p < pieceCount(bits, gSep) . ((getReg(z, runBase + p*pieceLen, pieceLen) + getReg(z, outBase + p*(pieceLen + 1), pieceLen))%2^pieceLen)*2^(p*pieceLen))


define rwDigit(cc, cm, q) = (cc >> (q*cm))%2^cm
define rwUpper(gSep, cm, pc, g, cc, p) = ((g - (Σ q < p . rwDigit(cc, cm, q)*2^((q + 1)*gSep)))%2^(pc*gSep + cm)) >> (p*gSep)
define rwPiece(gSep, cm, pc, g, cc, p) = if p + 1 < pc then rwUpper(gSep, cm, pc, g, cc, p)%2^gSep + 2^gSep*rwDigit(cc, cm, p) else rwUpper(gSep, cm, pc, g, cc, p)
define rwEnc(bits, gSep, cm, g, cc) = Σ p < pieceCount(bits, gSep) . rwPiece(gSep, cm, pieceCount(bits, gSep), g, cc, p)*2^(p*(gSep + cm))

define rwFoldSum(gSep, pieceLen, R, z, p) = getReg(z, R + (p + 1)*pieceLen, pieceLen - gSep) + getReg(z, R + p*pieceLen + gSep, pieceLen - gSep)
define rwFold(0, gSep, pieceLen, R, pc, z) = z
define rwFold(p+1, gSep, pieceLen, R, pc, z) = setReg(setReg(rwFold(p, gSep, pieceLen, R, pc, z), R + (p + 1)*pieceLen, pieceLen - gSep, rwFoldSum(gSep, pieceLen, R, z, p)%2^(pieceLen - gSep)), R + pc*pieceLen + p, 1, rwFoldSum(gSep, pieceLen, R, z, p) >> (pieceLen - gSep))
define rwFolded(bits, gSep, pieceLen, R, z) = rwFold(pieceCount(bits, gSep) - 1, gSep, pieceLen, R, pieceCount(bits, gSep), z)

define vwWord(bits, gSep, pieceLen, y) = Σ v < vwWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen) . bit(rwFolded(bits, gSep, pieceLen, 0, y), vwPos(bits, gSep, pieceLen, 0, v))*2^v

define rwPassSum(bits, gSep, pieceLen, wExp, wMul, x, y, e, m, pass, numWinMul, tSize) = Σ p < pieceCount(bits, gSep) . (((x >> (p*pieceLen))%2^pieceLen + (Σ k < numWinMul . (T[((2*m + pass)*numWinMul + k)*tSize + e + 2^wExp*((vwWord(bits, gSep, pieceLen, y) >> (k*wMul))%2^wMul)] >> (p*gSep))%2^gSep))%2^pieceLen)*2^(p*pieceLen)

define rwMulP(bits, gSep, pieceLen, wExp, wMul, x, y, e, m, numWinMul, tSize) = if m%2 = 0 then rwPassSum(bits, gSep, pieceLen, wExp, wMul, x, rwPassSum(bits, gSep, pieceLen, wExp, wMul, y, x, e, m, 0, numWinMul, tSize), e, m, 1, numWinMul, tSize) else rwPassSum(bits, gSep, pieceLen, wExp, wMul, x, y, e, m, 0, numWinMul, tSize)
define rwMulW(bits, gSep, pieceLen, wExp, wMul, x, y, e, m, numWinMul, tSize) = if m%2 = 0 then rwPassSum(bits, gSep, pieceLen, wExp, wMul, y, x, e, m, 0, numWinMul, tSize) else rwPassSum(bits, gSep, pieceLen, wExp, wMul, y, rwPassSum(bits, gSep, pieceLen, wExp, wMul, x, y, e, m, 0, numWinMul, tSize), e, m, 1, numWinMul, tSize)

define rwModStep(bits, gSep, pieceLen, wExp, wMul, state, e, m, numWinMul, tSize) = rwMulP(bits, gSep, pieceLen, wExp, wMul, state%2^(pieceCount(bits, gSep)*pieceLen), state//2^(pieceCount(bits, gSep)*pieceLen), (e >> (m*wExp))%2^wExp, m, numWinMul, tSize) + 2^(pieceCount(bits, gSep)*pieceLen)*rwMulW(bits, gSep, pieceLen, wExp, wMul, state%2^(pieceCount(bits, gSep)*pieceLen), state//2^(pieceCount(bits, gSep)*pieceLen), (e >> (m*wExp))%2^wExp, m, numWinMul, tSize)
define rwModState(0, bits, gSep, pieceLen, wExp, wMul, x, y, e, numWinMul, tSize) = x + 2^(pieceCount(bits, gSep)*pieceLen)*y
define rwModState(r+1, bits, gSep, pieceLen, wExp, wMul, x, y, e, numWinMul, tSize) = rwModStep(bits, gSep, pieceLen, wExp, wMul, rwModState(r, bits, gSep, pieceLen, wExp, wMul, x, y, e, numWinMul, tSize), e, r, numWinMul, tSize)

program ge2021Ideal[q: ctrl + 1, c: recSlots]:

  gePrepareRunways(bits, cm, N, Ninv, 1, gSep, pBase, outBase, addBase) @ id()
  gePrepareRunways(bits, cm, N, Ninv, 0, gSep, wBase, outBase, addBase) @ id()

  hadamards(expWire, nA + ehL) @ id()

  X(ctrl)

  gModExpIdealLoaded(wExp, wMul, W, bits, gSep, pieceLen, pBase, wBase, outBase, addrZone,
                     expWire, numMults, numWin, numWinMul,
                     tSize, ctrl, 0, nA) @ id()

  gIdealIQFT(expWire, nA + ehL, nA) @ id()

  gExpAllMeasure(1, expWire, nA + ehL,
                 2*numMults*numWinMul*((2^(wExp + wMul) - 1) + W
                   + (2^((wExp + wMul)//2) - (wExp + wMul)//2 - 1)
                   + (2^((wExp + wMul) - (wExp + wMul)//2)
                      - ((wExp + wMul) - (wExp + wMul)//2) - 1))) @ id()

  readout(bits, gSep, pieceLen, pBase, wBase, numMults,
          2*numMults*numWinMul*((2^(wExp + wMul) - 1) + W
            + (2^((wExp + wMul)//2) - (wExp + wMul)//2 - 1)
            + (2^((wExp + wMul) - (wExp + wMul)//2)
               - ((wExp + wMul) - (wExp + wMul)//2) - 1))
          + nA + ehL) @ id()

spec ge2021Ideal:
  requires  0 < wExp  ∧  0 < numMults  ∧  0 < nA
            ∧  0 < cm  ∧  cm < gSep  ∧  pieceLen = gSep + cm
            ∧  4^(ehB + 1)*(2*numMults*(pieceCount(bits, gSep)*numWinMul + 2)) ≤ 2^cm
            ∧  (pieceCount(bits, gSep) = 1
                ∨  2^((pieceCount(bits, gSep) - 1)*gSep + cm + 1) ≤ N)
            ∧  N%2 = 1  ∧  N < 2^bits  ∧  N*Ninv%2^(bits + cm) = 1  ∧  Ninv < 2^(bits + cm)
            ∧  1 < g  ∧  g < N  ∧  0 < gInv  ∧  gInv < N  ∧  g*gInv%N = 1
            ∧  0 < wMul  ∧  N < 2^W
            ∧  tSize = 2^(wExp + wMul)  ∧  0 < numWinMul
            ∧  (∀ a < 2*numMults*numWinMul*tSize . T[a] < 2^W)
            ∧  (∀ m < numMults . ∀ pass < 2 . ∀ k < numWinMul . ∀ a < tSize .
                  T[((2*m + pass)*numWinMul + k)*tSize + a]
                    = geTableValue(bits, N, g, gInv, wExp, wMul, gSep, pieceLen,
                                   nA, nA + ehL, m, pass, k, a))
            ∧  (∀ b < 2*numMults*numWinMul . ∀ i < W . ∀ lo < 2^halfLo(wExp + wMul) .
                  Tbar[(b*tSize)*(W*2^halfLo(wExp + wMul)) + i*2^halfLo(wExp + wMul) + lo]
                    = gePhaseWord(wExp + wMul, b*tSize, i, lo))
            ∧  numWinMul = ceilDiv(vwWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen), wMul)
            ∧  1 ≤ ehL  ∧  2 ≤ ehM  ∧  ehD < 2^ehM
            ∧  5 ≤ nA  ∧  0 < ehA  ∧  0 < ehR0  ∧  ehR0 ≤ 2^ehM
            ∧  nA = ehL + ehM  ∧  numMults = ceilDiv(nA + ehL, wExp)
            ∧  (∀ t < 2^nA + ehD*(2^ehL - 1) . t = 0 ∨ g^t%N ≠ 1)
            ∧  4*N ≤ ehSum(ehD, ehM)*ehSum(ehD, ehM)
            ∧  ehRootEq(ehFactorHigh(ehSum(ehD, ehM), N), ehSum(ehD, ehM), N)
            ∧  ehRootEq(ehFactorLow(ehSum(ehD, ehM), N), ehSum(ehD, ehM), N)
            ∧  1 < ehFactorLow(ehSum(ehD, ehM), N)
            ∧  ehFactorLow(ehSum(ehD, ehM), N) < ehFactorHigh(ehSum(ehD, ehM), N)
            ∧  (∀ a < ehFactorLow(ehSum(ehD, ehM), N) . a < 2 ∨ ehFactorLow(ehSum(ehD, ehM), N)%a ≠ 0)
            ∧  (∀ a < ehFactorHigh(ehSum(ehD, ehM), N) . a < 2 ∨ ehFactorHigh(ehSum(ehD, ehM), N)%a ≠ 0)
            ∧  recSlots = measLaChain(wExp, wMul, W, numMults, numWinMul)
                          + nA + ehL + regWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen)
            ∧  ctrl + 1 + recSlots ≤ dim
            ∧  ge2021Layout(bits, cm, pBase, wBase, outBase, addBase, addrZone, expWire,
                            ctrl, gSep, pieceLen, wExp, wMul, numMults)
            ∧  0 < bits  ∧  0 < W  ∧  W ≤ gSep*pieceCount(bits, gSep)
  assumes   {{ |0⟩_q[0, dim) }}
  ensures   {{ |0⟩_q[expWire, expWire + numMults*wExp)
               ⊗ |0⟩_q[addrZone, addrZone + zoneStride(wExp, wMul))
               ⊗ |0⟩_q[outBase, outBase + outWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen)) }}
  outcomes  Pr[ ehRecoverable(ehM, ehL, ehD, ehA, ehR0,
                              c[measLaChain(wExp, wMul, W, numMults, numWinMul),
                                measLaChain(wExp, wMul, W, numMults, numWinMul) + nA),
                              c[measLaChain(wExp, wMul, W, numMults, numWinMul) + nA,
                                measLaChain(wExp, wMul, W, numMults, numWinMul) + nA + ehL)) ]
              ≥  1 - ehTail(ehM, ehL, ehA, ehR0) - 1/2^ehB
  resource  { toffoli: 2*toffPrepRunways(bits, cm, gSep)
                       + toffLaChain(wExp, wMul, bits, gSep, pieceLen, numMults, numWinMul),
              t: 7*(2*toffPrepRunways(bits, cm, gSep)
                    + toffLaChain(wExp, wMul, bits, gSep, pieceLen, numMults, numWinMul))
                 + (Σ p < nA + ehL . tIdealRead(1, nA, p)),
              clifford: cliffPrepRunways(bits, cm, gSep, N, Ninv, 1)
                        + cliffPrepRunways(bits, cm, gSep, N, Ninv, 0)
                        + nA + ehL + 1
                        + cliffLaChain(wExp, wMul, W, bits, gSep, pieceLen,
                                       numMults, numWinMul, tSize)
                        + (Σ p < nA + ehL . cliffIdealRead(1, nA, p))
                        + nA + ehL,
              rot: (Σ p < nA + ehL . rotIdealRead(1, nA, p)),
              meas: measLaChain(wExp, wMul, W, numMults, numWinMul)
                    + nA + ehL + regWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen),
              qubits: 2*regWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen) + outWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen)
                      + zoneStride(wExp, wMul) + numMults*wExp + 1 }

gadget cosetPrepFromZero[q: max(regBase + bits, max(accBase + bits, addBase + bits + 1))]
                        (bits, cm, N, Ninv, k, regBase, accBase, addBase):
  hadamards(regBase, cm) @ id()
  mulFromLowConst(bits, cm, N, Ninv, regBase, accBase, addBase) @ id()
  addConstInto(bits, k, regBase, addBase) @ id()

spec cosetPrepFromZero:
  ∀α .
  requires  0 < cm  ∧  cm ≤ bits  ∧  k < N  ∧  N%2 = 1
            ∧  N*Ninv%2^bits = 1  ∧  Ninv < 2^bits  ∧  N < 2^bits
            ∧  regBase + bits ≤ accBase  ∧  accBase + bits ≤ addBase
            ∧  addBase + bits + 1 ≤ dim
  assumes   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z)
                 * |prepZeroWord(bits, regBase, accBase, addBase, z)⟩_q[0, dim) }}
  ensures   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . (Σ j < 2^cm .
                 (α(z) * (1/sqrt(2^cm)))
                   * |setReg(prepZeroWord(bits, regBase, accBase, addBase, z), regBase, bits,
                             k + j*N)⟩_q[0, dim)) }}
  outcomes  none
  resource  { toffoli: toffCosetPrep(bits, cm),
              t: 7*toffCosetPrep(bits, cm),
              clifford: cliffCosetPrep(bits, cm, N, Ninv, k),
              rot: 0, meas: 0,
              qubits: 3*bits + 1 }

gadget gePrepareRunways[q: max(regBase + ((bits + gSep - 1)//gSep)*(gSep + cm), addBase + bits + cm + 1)]
                       (bits, cm, N, Ninv, k, gSep, regBase, accBase, addBase):
  cosetPrepFromZero(bits + cm, cm, N, Ninv, k, regBase, accBase, addBase) @ id()
  geInsertRunways(bits, cm, gSep, regBase, addBase) @ id()

spec gePrepareRunways:
  ∀α .
    requires  0 < cm  ∧  cm < gSep  ∧  0 < bits  ∧  k < N  ∧  N%2 = 1  ∧  N < 2^bits
              ∧  N*Ninv%2^(bits + cm) = 1  ∧  Ninv < 2^(bits + cm)
              ∧  regBase + pieceCount(bits, gSep)*(gSep + cm) ≤ accBase
              ∧  accBase + bits + cm ≤ addBase  ∧  addBase + bits + cm + 1 ≤ dim
    assumes   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z)
                 * |setReg(prepZeroWord(bits + cm, regBase, accBase, addBase, z), regBase,
                           pieceCount(bits, gSep)*(gSep + cm), 0)⟩_q[0, dim) }}
    ensures   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . (Σ t < 2^(pieceCount(bits, gSep)*cm) .
                 (α(z) * (1/sqrt(2^(pieceCount(bits, gSep)*cm))))
                 * |setReg(prepZeroWord(bits + cm, regBase, accBase, addBase, z), regBase,
                           pieceCount(bits, gSep)*(gSep + cm),
                           rwEnc(bits, gSep, cm, k + (t%2^cm)*N, t >> cm))⟩_q[0, dim)) }}
    outcomes  none
    resource  { toffoli: toffPrepRunways(bits, cm, gSep),
                t: 7*toffPrepRunways(bits, cm, gSep),
                clifford: cliffPrepRunways(bits, cm, gSep, N, Ninv, k),
                rot: 0, meas: 0,
                qubits: pieceCount(bits, gSep)*(gSep + cm) + 2*(bits + cm) + 1 }

gadget geInsertRunways[q: max(regBase + ((bits + gSep - 1)//gSep)*(gSep + cm), addBase + bits + cm + 1)]
                      (bits, cm, gSep, regBase, addBase):
  for 0 ≤ p < ((bits + gSep - 1)//gSep) - 1:
    geInsertRunway(bits, cm, gSep, p, regBase, addBase) @ id()

spec geInsertRunways:
  ∀α .
    requires  0 < cm  ∧  cm < gSep  ∧  0 < bits
              ∧  regBase + pieceCount(bits, gSep)*(gSep + cm) ≤ addBase
              ∧  addBase + bits + cm + 1 ≤ dim
    assumes   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z)
                 * |setReg(setReg(z, regBase + bits + cm,
                                  pieceCount(bits, gSep)*(gSep + cm) - bits - cm, 0),
                           addBase, bits + cm + 1, 0)⟩_q[0, dim) }}
    ensures   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . (Σ cc < 2^((pieceCount(bits, gSep) - 1)*cm) .
                 (α(z) * (1/sqrt(2^((pieceCount(bits, gSep) - 1)*cm))))
                 * |setReg(setReg(setReg(z, regBase + bits + cm,
                                         pieceCount(bits, gSep)*(gSep + cm) - bits - cm, 0),
                                  addBase, bits + cm + 1, 0),
                           regBase, pieceCount(bits, gSep)*(gSep + cm),
                           rwEnc(bits, gSep, cm, getReg(z, regBase, bits + cm), cc))⟩_q[0, dim)) }}
    outcomes  none
    resource  { toffoli: toffInsertRunways(bits, cm, gSep),
                t: 7*toffInsertRunways(bits, cm, gSep),
                clifford: cliffInsertRunways(bits, cm, gSep),
                rot: 0, meas: 0 }

gadget geInsertRunway[q: max(regBase + ((bits + gSep - 1)//gSep)*(gSep + cm), addBase + bits + cm + 1)]
                     (bits, cm, gSep, p, regBase, addBase):
  geShiftUp((((bits + gSep - 1)//gSep) - p - 1)*gSep + cm, cm,
            regBase + p*(gSep + cm) + gSep) @ id()
  hadamards(regBase + p*(gSep + cm) + gSep, cm) @ id()
  geSubRunway((((bits + gSep - 1)//gSep) - p - 1)*gSep + cm, cm,
              regBase + p*(gSep + cm) + gSep, regBase + (p + 1)*(gSep + cm), addBase) @ id()

spec geInsertRunway:
  ∀α .
    requires  0 < cm  ∧  cm < gSep  ∧  p + 1 < pieceCount(bits, gSep)
              ∧  regBase + pieceCount(bits, gSep)*(gSep + cm) ≤ addBase
              ∧  addBase + bits + cm + 1 ≤ dim
    assumes   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z)
                 * |setReg(setReg(z, regBase + p*(gSep + cm) + gSep
                                       + (pieceCount(bits, gSep) - p - 1)*gSep + cm, cm, 0),
                           addBase, (pieceCount(bits, gSep) - p - 1)*gSep + cm + 1, 0)⟩_q[0, dim) }}
    ensures   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . (Σ d < 2^cm . (α(z) * (1/sqrt(2^cm)))
                 * |setReg(setReg(setReg(z, regBase + p*(gSep + cm) + gSep
                                              + (pieceCount(bits, gSep) - p - 1)*gSep + cm,
                                         cm, 0),
                                  addBase, (pieceCount(bits, gSep) - p - 1)*gSep + cm + 1, 0),
                           regBase + p*(gSep + cm) + gSep,
                           cm + (pieceCount(bits, gSep) - p - 1)*gSep + cm,
                           d + 2^cm*((getReg(z, regBase + p*(gSep + cm) + gSep,
                                             (pieceCount(bits, gSep) - p - 1)*gSep + cm) - d)
                                     %2^((pieceCount(bits, gSep) - p - 1)*gSep + cm)))⟩_q[0, dim)) }}
    outcomes  none
    resource  { toffoli: toffRelocAdder((pieceCount(bits, gSep) - p - 1)*gSep + cm),
                t: 7*toffRelocAdder((pieceCount(bits, gSep) - p - 1)*gSep + cm),
                clifford: 9*((pieceCount(bits, gSep) - p - 1)*gSep + cm) + 3*cm,
                rot: 0, meas: 0 }

gadget geShiftUp[q: base + n + s](n, s, base):
  for 0 ≤ j < n:
    accYSwapG(1, base + n - 1 - j, 1, base + n - 1 - j + s, 1) @ id()

spec geShiftUp:
  ∀α .
    requires  0 < s  ∧  base + n + s ≤ dim
    assumes   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z) * |setReg(z, base + n, s, 0)⟩_q[0, dim) }}
    ensures   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z)
                 * |setReg(setReg(z, base + n, s, 0), base, n + s, 2^s*getReg(z, base, n))⟩_q[0, dim) }}
    outcomes  none
    resource  { toffoli: 0, t: 0, clifford: 3*n, rot: 0, meas: 0 }

gadget geSubRunway[q: addBase + n + 1](n, cm, rBase, uBase, addBase):
  cPrepConst(uBase, 2^n - 1, n) @ id()
  cxCascade(cm, 1, rBase, 1, addBase) @ id()
  relocAdder(n, uBase, addBase) @ id()
  cxCascade(cm, 1, rBase, 1, addBase) @ id()
  cPrepConst(uBase, 2^n - 1, n) @ id()

spec geSubRunway:
  ∀α .
    requires  0 < cm  ∧  cm ≤ n  ∧  rBase + cm ≤ uBase  ∧  uBase + n ≤ addBase
              ∧  addBase + n + 1 ≤ dim
    assumes   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z) * |setReg(z, addBase, n + 1, 0)⟩_q[0, dim) }}
    ensures   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z)
                 * |setReg(setReg(z, addBase, n + 1, 0), uBase, n,
                           (getReg(z, uBase, n) - getReg(z, rBase, cm))%2^n)⟩_q[0, dim) }}
    outcomes  none
    resource  { toffoli: toffRelocAdder(n), t: 7*toffRelocAdder(n),
                clifford: 2*n + 2*cm + cliffRelocAdder(n), rot: 0, meas: 0 }

gadget mulInPlaceConst[q: addBase + bits + 1](bits, cst, cstInv, regBase, accBase, addBase):
  mulAccConst(bits, cst, regBase, accBase, addBase) @ id()
  accYSwapG(bits, regBase, 1, accBase, 1) @ id()
  mulAccConst(bits, (2^bits - cstInv)%2^bits, regBase, accBase, addBase) @ id()

gadget mulAccConst[q: addBase + bits + 1](bits, cst, srcBase, accBase, addBase):
  for 0 ≤ i < bits:
    ctrlAddConst(bits, (cst*2^i)%2^bits, srcBase + i, accBase, addBase) @ id()


gadget mulAccConstLow[q: addBase + bits + 1](bits, low, cst, srcBase, accBase, addBase):
  for 0 ≤ i < low:
    ctrlAddConst(bits, (cst*2^i)%2^bits, srcBase + i, accBase, addBase) @ id()

gadget mulFromLowConst[q: addBase + bits + 1](bits, low, cst, cstInv, regBase, accBase, addBase):
  mulAccConstLow(bits, low, cst, regBase, accBase, addBase) @ id()
  accYSwapG(bits, regBase, 1, accBase, 1) @ id()
  mulAccConst(bits, (2^bits - cstInv)%2^bits, regBase, accBase, addBase) @ id()

spec mulFromLowConst:
  ∀α .
    requires  0 < bits  ∧  0 < low  ∧  low ≤ bits
              ∧  cst*cstInv%2^bits = 1  ∧  cstInv < 2^bits  ∧  cst < 2^bits
              ∧  regBase + bits ≤ accBase  ∧  accBase + bits ≤ addBase
              ∧  addBase + bits + 1 ≤ dim
    assumes   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z)
                   * |mulPrepWord(bits, low, regBase, accBase, addBase, z)⟩_q[0, dim) }}
    ensures   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z)
                   * |setReg(mulPrepWord(bits, low, regBase, accBase, addBase, z), regBase, bits,
                             cst*getReg(z, regBase, low))⟩_q[0, dim) }}
    outcomes  none
    resource  { toffoli: toffMulFromLow(bits, low),
                t: 7*toffMulFromLow(bits, low),
                clifford: cliffMulFromLow(bits, cst, cstInv, low),
                rot: 0, meas: 0,
                qubits: 3*bits + 1 }

gadget ctrlAddConst[q: addBase + bits + 1](bits, cst, ctrlIdx, accBase, addBase):
  cPrepMasked(ctrlIdx, addBase, cst, bits) @ id()
  relocAdder(bits, accBase, addBase) @ id()
  cPrepMasked(ctrlIdx, addBase, cst, bits) @ id()

gadget addConstInto[q: addBase + bits + 1](bits, cst, accBase, addBase):
  cPrepConst(addBase, cst, bits) @ id()
  relocAdder(bits, accBase, addBase) @ id()
  cPrepConst(addBase, cst, bits) @ id()

gadget cPrepMasked[q: addBase + n](ctrlIdx, addBase, cst, n):
  for 0 ≤ i < n:
    if (cst >> i) % 2 = 1:
      CX(ctrlIdx, addBase + i)

gadget cPrepConst[q: addBase + n](addBase, cst, n):
  for 0 ≤ i < n:
    if (cst >> i) % 2 = 1:
      X(addBase + i)

gadget cxCascade[q: max(cBase + cStride*n, tBase + tStride*n)](n, cStride, cBase, tStride, tBase):
  for 0 ≤ i < n:
    CX(cBase + cStride*i, tBase + tStride*i)

gadget accYSwapG[q: max(aBase + aStride*bits, yBase + yStride*bits)]
                (bits, aBase, aStride, yBase, yStride):
  cxCascade(bits, aStride, aBase, yStride, yBase) @ id()
  cxCascade(bits, yStride, yBase, aStride, aBase) @ id()
  cxCascade(bits, aStride, aBase, yStride, yBase) @ id()

gadget relocAdder[q: addBase + n + 1](n, accBase, addBase):
  relocMajChain(n, accBase, addBase) @ id()
  relocUmaChainRev(n, accBase, addBase) @ id()

gadget relocMajChain[q: addBase + n + 1](n, accBase, addBase):
  for 0 ≤ k < n:
    if k = 0:
      cuccaroMAJ(addBase + n, accBase, addBase) @ id()
    else:
      cuccaroMAJ(addBase + k - 1, accBase + k, addBase + k) @ id()

gadget relocUmaChainRev[q: addBase + n + 1](n, accBase, addBase):
  for 0 ≤ k < n:
    if n - 1 - k = 0:
      cuccaroUMA(addBase + n, accBase, addBase) @ id()
    else:
      cuccaroUMA(addBase + n - 2 - k, accBase + n - 1 - k, addBase + n - 1 - k) @ id()

gadget cuccaroMAJ[q: max(a, max(b, cin)) + 1](a, b, cin):
  CX(cin, b)
  CX(cin, a)
  CCX(a, b, cin)

gadget cuccaroUMA[q: max(a, max(b, cin)) + 1](a, b, cin):
  CCX(a, b, cin)
  CX(cin, a)
  CX(a, b)

spec mulInPlaceConst:
  ∀α .
    requires  0 < bits  ∧  cst*cstInv%2^bits = 1  ∧  cstInv < 2^bits  ∧  cst < 2^bits
              ∧  regBase + bits ≤ accBase  ∧  accBase + bits ≤ addBase
              ∧  addBase + bits + 1 ≤ dim
    assumes   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z)
                   * |setReg(setReg(z, accBase, bits, 0), addBase, bits + 1, 0)⟩_q[0, dim) }}
    ensures   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z)
                   * |setReg(setReg(setReg(z, accBase, bits, 0), addBase, bits + 1, 0),
                             regBase, bits, cst*getReg(z, regBase, bits))⟩_q[0, dim) }}
    outcomes  none
    resource  { toffoli: toffMulInPlace(bits),
                t: 7*toffMulInPlace(bits),
                clifford: cliffMulInPlace(bits, cst, cstInv),
                rot: 0, meas: 0,
                qubits: 3*bits + 1 }

gadget hadamards[q: base + n](base, n):
  for 0 ≤ i < n:
    H(base + i)

spec hadamards:
  ∀α .
  requires  0 < n  ∧  base + n ≤ dim
  assumes   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z) * |setReg(z, base, n, 0)⟩_q[0, dim) }}
  ensures   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . (Σ e < 2^n .
                 (α(z) * (1/sqrt(2^n))) * |setReg(z, base, n, e)⟩_q[0, dim)) }}
  outcomes  none
  resource  { toffoli: 0, t: 0, clifford: n, rot: 0, meas: 0,
              depth: 1, width: n, ops: n,
              qubits: n }

gadget holdCtrl[q: ctrl + 1](ctrl):
  X(ctrl)

spec holdCtrl:
  ∀α .
  requires  ctrl < dim
  assumes   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z) * |setReg(z, ctrl, 1, 0)⟩_q[0, dim) }}
  ensures   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z) * |setReg(z, ctrl, 1, 1)⟩_q[0, dim) }}
  outcomes  none
  resource  { toffoli: 0, t: 0, clifford: 1, rot: 0, meas: 0,
              depth: 1, width: 1, ops: 1,
              qubits: 1 }

gadget gModExpIdealLoaded[q: dim, c: dim](wExp, wMul, W, bits, gSep, pieceLen, pBase, wBase,
                                          outBase, addrZone, expWire, numMults, numWin,
                                          numWinMul, tSize, ctrl, cb, nA):
  for 0 ≤ m < numMults:
    gMultiplicationRwLoaded(wExp, wMul, W, bits, gSep, pieceLen, pBase, wBase,
                            outBase, addrZone, expWire, m, m, numWin, numWinMul,
                            tSize, ctrl,
                            cb + m*(2*numWinMul*((2^(wExp + wMul) - 1) + W
                                     + (2^((wExp + wMul)//2) - (wExp + wMul)//2 - 1)
                                     + (2^((wExp + wMul) - (wExp + wMul)//2)
                                        - ((wExp + wMul) - (wExp + wMul)//2) - 1)))) @ id()

spec gModExpIdealLoaded:
  ∀α .
  requires  0 < numMults  ∧  0 < numWinMul  ∧  0 < wExp  ∧  0 < wMul
            ∧  numWinMul = ceilDiv(vwWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen), wMul)
            ∧  pBase + regWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen) ≤ wBase
            ∧  wBase + regWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen) ≤ outBase
            ∧  outBase + outWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen) ≤ addrZone
            ∧  addrZone + zoneStride(wExp, wMul) ≤ expWire
            ∧  expWire + numMults*wExp ≤ ctrl  ∧  ctrl < dim
            ∧  ctrl < cb
            ∧  cb + measLaChain(wExp, wMul, W, numMults, numWinMul) ≤ dim
            ∧  0 < bits  ∧  0 < gSep  ∧  gSep < pieceLen  ∧  pieceLen < 2*gSep
            ∧  0 < W  ∧  W ≤ gSep*pieceCount(bits, gSep)
            ∧ tSize = 2^(wExp + wMul)
            ∧ (∀ m < numMults . ∀ pass < 2 . ∀ k < numWinMul . ∀ a < 2^(wExp + wMul) .
                 0 ≤ T[((2*m + pass)*numWinMul + k)*tSize + a]

gadget gMultiplyAddRwLoaded[q: dim, c: dim](wExp, wMul, W, bits, gSep, pieceLen, pBase,
                                            wBase, outBase, addrZone, eBase, eWin, m, pass, numWin,
                                            numWinMul, tSize, ctrl, cb):
  geFoldRunways(bits, gSep, pieceLen, pBase + ((m + pass)%2)*(wBase - pBase), outBase) @ id()
  for 0 ≤ k < numWinMul:
    gLaRwAtLoaded(wExp, wMul, W, bits, gSep, pieceLen,
                  pBase + ((m + pass)%2)*(wBase - pBase),
                  pBase + ((m + pass + 1)%2)*(wBase - pBase),
                  outBase, addrZone, eBase, eWin, m, k, ctrl,
                  ((2*m + pass)*numWinMul + k)*tSize,
                  cb + k*((2^(wExp + wMul) - 1) + W
                          + (2^((wExp + wMul)//2) - (wExp + wMul)//2 - 1)
                          + (2^((wExp + wMul) - (wExp + wMul)//2)
                             - ((wExp + wMul) - (wExp + wMul)//2) - 1))) @ id()
  geUnfoldRunways(bits, gSep, pieceLen, pBase + ((m + pass)%2)*(wBase - pBase), outBase) @ id()

spec gMultiplyAddRwLoaded:
  ∀α .
  requires  0 < numWinMul  ∧  0 < wMul  ∧  0 < wExp  ∧  pass < 2 ∧  numWinMul = ceilDiv(vwWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen), wMul) ∧  pBase + regWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen) ≤ wBase ∧  wBase + regWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen) ≤ outBase ∧  outBase + outWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen) ≤ addrZone ∧  addrZone + zoneStride(wExp, wMul) ≤ eBase ∧  eBase + (eWin + 1)*wExp ≤ ctrl  ∧  ctrl < dim ∧  ctrl < cb ∧  cb + numWinMul*measLookupAdd(wExp + wMul, W) ≤ dim ∧  0 < bits  ∧  0 < gSep  ∧  gSep < pieceLen  ∧  pieceLen < 2*gSep ∧  0 < W  ∧  W ≤ gSep*pieceCount(bits, gSep)
            ∧ (∀ k < numWinMul . ∀ a < 2^(wExp + wMul) .

                 ∧ T[((2*m + pass)*numWinMul + k)*tSize + a] < 2^W)
            ∧ (∀ k < numWinMul . ∀ i < W . ∀ lo < 2^halfLo(wExp + wMul) .

                        + i*2^halfLo(wExp + wMul) + lo]

  assumes   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z)
                 * |setReg(setReg(setReg(setReg(setReg(setReg(z, pBase + pieceCount(bits, gSep)*pieceLen, pieceCount(bits, gSep), 0),

  ensures   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z)

                     ctrl, 1, 1),

                           + cliffLookupAdd(wExp + wMul, W, bits, gSep, pieceLen,

gadget gLaRwAtLoaded[q: dim, c: dim](wExp, wMul, W, bits, gSep, pieceLen, srcBase, tgtBase,
                                     outBase, addrZone, eBase, eWin, m, k, ctrl, tOff, cb):
  copyWindowTo(wExp, eBase,   eWin, addrZone) @ id()
  geCopyFoldedWindow(bits, gSep, pieceLen, srcBase, wMul, k, addrZone + wExp) @ id()
  gLaRunwayAt(wExp + wMul, W, bits, gSep, pieceLen,
              addrZone,
              addrZone + (wExp + wMul),
              addrZone + 2*(wExp + wMul),
              addrZone + 2*(wExp + wMul) + 2^((wExp + wMul)//2),
              tgtBase, outBase, ctrl, tOff, cb) @ id()
  geCopyFoldedWindow(bits, gSep, pieceLen, srcBase, wMul, k, addrZone + wExp) @ id()
  copyWindowTo(wExp, eBase,   eWin, addrZone) @ id()

spec gLaRwAtLoaded:
  ∀α .
  requires  0 < wExp  ∧  0 < wMul ∧  (srcBase + regWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen) ≤ tgtBase ∨ tgtBase + regWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen) ≤ srcBase) ∧  addrZone + zoneStride(wExp, wMul) ≤ eBase + eWin*wExp ∧  eBase + (eWin + 1)*wExp ≤ ctrl ∧  tgtBase + regWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen) ≤ outBase ∧  srcBase + regWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen) ≤ outBase ∧  outBase + outWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen) ≤ addrZone ∧  addrZone + zoneStride(wExp, wMul) ≤ ctrl ∧  ctrl < dim ∧  ctrl < cb ∧  cb + measLookupAdd(wExp + wMul, W) ≤ dim ∧  0 < bits  ∧  0 < gSep  ∧  0 < pieceLen  ∧  gSep ≤ pieceLen ∧  0 < W  ∧  W ≤ gSep*pieceCount(bits, gSep)
            ∧ (∀ a < 2^(wExp + wMul) . 0 ≤ T[tOff + a] ∧ T[tOff + a] < 2^W)
            ∧ (∀ i < W . ∀ lo < 2^halfLo(wExp + wMul) .
                 Tbar[tOff*(W*2^halfLo(wExp + wMul)) + i*2^halfLo(wExp + wMul) + lo]
                   = gePhaseWord(wExp + wMul, tOff, i, lo))
  assumes   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z)
                 * |setReg(setReg(setReg(setReg(z, outBase, outWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen), 0),
                            addrZone, zoneStride(wExp, wMul), 0),
                     ctrl, 1, 1),
              cb, measLookupAdd(wExp + wMul, W), 0)⟩_q[0, dim) }}
  ensures   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z)
                 * (|setReg(setReg(setReg(setReg(z, outBase, outWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen), 0),
                            addrZone, zoneStride(wExp, wMul), 0),
                     ctrl, 1, 1),
              tgtBase, pieceCount(bits, gSep)*pieceLen,
              runwayLookupAdd(bits, gSep, pieceLen,
                              getReg(z, tgtBase, pieceCount(bits, gSep)*pieceLen),
                              T[tOff + getReg(z, eBase + eWin*wExp, wExp)
                                     + 2^wExp*vwWindow(bits, gSep, pieceLen, srcBase, wMul, k, z)]))⟩_q[0, cb)
                    ⊗ |setReg(setReg(setReg(setReg(z, outBase, outWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen), 0),
                            addrZone, zoneStride(wExp, wMul), 0),
                     ctrl, 1, 1),
              tgtBase, pieceCount(bits, gSep)*pieceLen,

gadget copyWindowTo[q: max((yBase + j*w + w), (addrBase + w))]
                   (w, yBase, j, addrBase):
  for 0 ≤ i < w:
    CX((yBase + j*w + i), (addrBase + i))

spec copyWindowTo:
  ∀α .
    requires  0 < w
              ∧  (∀ i < w . ∀ i2 < w . copySrc(w, yBase, j, i) ≠ copyTgt(addrBase, i2))
              ∧  copySrc(w, yBase, j, w) ≤ dim  ∧  copyTgt(addrBase, w) ≤ dim
    assumes   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z) * |z⟩_q[0, dim) }}
    ensures   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z) * |copyWindow(w, z, w, yBase, j, addrBase)⟩_q[0, dim) }}
    outcomes  none
    resource  { toffoli: 0, t: 0, clifford: w, rot: 0, meas: 0,
                depth: 1, width: w, ops: w }

gadget geFoldOne[q: addBase + cm + 2](cm, rBase, accBase, zPos, addBase):
  accYSwapG(1, accBase + cm, 1, zPos, 1) @ id()
  cxCascade(cm, 1, rBase, 1, addBase) @ id()
  relocAdder(cm + 1, accBase, addBase) @ id()
  cxCascade(cm, 1, rBase, 1, addBase) @ id()
  accYSwapG(1, accBase + cm, 1, zPos, 1) @ id()

spec geFoldOne:
  ∀α .
    requires  0 < cm  ∧  rBase + cm ≤ accBase  ∧  accBase + cm + 1 ≤ zPos  ∧  zPos < addBase
              ∧  addBase + cm + 2 ≤ dim
    assumes   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z) * |setReg(setReg(z, zPos, 1, 0), addBase, cm + 2, 0)⟩_q[0, dim) }}
    ensures   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z)
                 * |setReg(setReg(setReg(setReg(z, zPos, 1, 0), addBase, cm + 2, 0), accBase, cm,
                                  (getReg(z, accBase, cm) + getReg(z, rBase, cm))%2^cm),
                           zPos, 1, (getReg(z, accBase, cm) + getReg(z, rBase, cm)) >> cm)⟩_q[0, dim) }}
    outcomes  none
    resource  { toffoli: toffRelocAdder(cm + 1), t: 7*toffRelocAdder(cm + 1),
                clifford: 6 + 2*cm + cliffRelocAdder(cm + 1), rot: 0, meas: 0 }

gadget geUnfoldOne[q: addBase + cm + 2](cm, rBase, accBase, zPos, addBase):
  accYSwapG(1, accBase + cm, 1, zPos, 1) @ id()
  cPrepConst(accBase, 2^(cm + 1) - 1, cm + 1) @ id()
  cxCascade(cm, 1, rBase, 1, addBase) @ id()
  relocAdder(cm + 1, accBase, addBase) @ id()
  cxCascade(cm, 1, rBase, 1, addBase) @ id()
  cPrepConst(accBase, 2^(cm + 1) - 1, cm + 1) @ id()
  accYSwapG(1, accBase + cm, 1, zPos, 1) @ id()

spec geUnfoldOne:
  ∀α .
    requires  0 < cm  ∧  rBase + cm ≤ accBase  ∧  accBase + cm + 1 ≤ zPos  ∧  zPos < addBase
              ∧  addBase + cm + 2 ≤ dim
    assumes   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z) * |setReg(z, addBase, cm + 2, 0)⟩_q[0, dim) }}
    ensures   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z)
                 * |setReg(setReg(setReg(z, addBase, cm + 2, 0), accBase, cm,
                                  (getReg(z, accBase, cm) + 2^cm*bit(z, zPos) - getReg(z, rBase, cm))
                                    %2^(cm + 1)%2^cm),
                           zPos, 1, (getReg(z, accBase, cm) + 2^cm*bit(z, zPos) - getReg(z, rBase, cm))
                                      %2^(cm + 1) >> cm)⟩_q[0, dim) }}
    outcomes  none
    resource  { toffoli: toffRelocAdder(cm + 1), t: 7*toffRelocAdder(cm + 1),
                clifford: 8 + 4*cm + cliffRelocAdder(cm + 1), rot: 0, meas: 0 }

gadget geFoldRunways[q: max(R + ((bits + gSep - 1)//gSep)*(pieceLen + 1), outBase + pieceLen - gSep + 2)](bits, gSep, pieceLen, R, outBase):
  for 0 ≤ p < ((bits + gSep - 1)//gSep) - 1:
    geFoldOne(pieceLen - gSep, R + p*pieceLen + gSep, R + (p + 1)*pieceLen,
              R + ((bits + gSep - 1)//gSep)*pieceLen + p,
              outBase) @ id()

spec geFoldRunways:
  ∀α .
    requires  0 < bits  ∧  0 < gSep  ∧  gSep < pieceLen  ∧  pieceLen < 2*gSep
              ∧  R + regWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen) ≤ outBase
              ∧  outBase + pieceLen - gSep + 2 ≤ dim
    assumes   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z)
                 * |setReg(setReg(z, R + pieceCount(bits, gSep)*pieceLen, pieceCount(bits, gSep), 0),
                           outBase, pieceLen - gSep + 2, 0)⟩_q[0, dim) }}
    ensures   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z)
                 * |rwFolded(bits, gSep, pieceLen, R,
                             setReg(setReg(z, R + pieceCount(bits, gSep)*pieceLen, pieceCount(bits, gSep), 0),
                                    outBase, pieceLen - gSep + 2, 0))⟩_q[0, dim) }}
    outcomes  none
    resource  { toffoli: (pieceCount(bits, gSep) - 1)*toffRelocAdder(pieceLen - gSep + 1),
                t: 7*(pieceCount(bits, gSep) - 1)*toffRelocAdder(pieceLen - gSep + 1),
                clifford: (pieceCount(bits, gSep) - 1)*(6*(pieceLen - gSep) + 10),
                rot: 0, meas: 0 }

gadget geUnfoldRunways[q: max(R + ((bits + gSep - 1)//gSep)*(pieceLen + 1), outBase + pieceLen - gSep + 2)](bits, gSep, pieceLen, R, outBase):
  for ((bits + gSep - 1)//gSep) - 1 > p ≥ 0:
    geUnfoldOne(pieceLen - gSep, R + p*pieceLen + gSep, R + (p + 1)*pieceLen,
                R + ((bits + gSep - 1)//gSep)*pieceLen + p,
                outBase) @ id()

spec geUnfoldRunways:
  ∀α .
    requires  0 < bits  ∧  0 < gSep  ∧  gSep < pieceLen  ∧  pieceLen < 2*gSep

gadget geCopyFoldedWindow[q: max(R + ((bits + gSep - 1)//gSep)*(pieceLen + 1), addrBase + wMul)]
                         (bits, gSep, pieceLen, R, wMul, k, addrBase):
  for k*wMul ≤ v < min((k + 1)*wMul, (((bits + gSep - 1)//gSep) - 1)*gSep):
    CX(R + (v//gSep)*pieceLen + v%gSep, addrBase + v - k*wMul)
  for max(k*wMul, (((bits + gSep - 1)//gSep) - 1)*gSep) ≤ v < min((k + 1)*wMul, (((bits + gSep - 1)//gSep) - 1)*gSep + pieceLen):
    CX(R + (((bits + gSep - 1)//gSep) - 1)*pieceLen + v - (((bits + gSep - 1)//gSep) - 1)*gSep, addrBase + v - k*wMul)
  for max(k*wMul, (((bits + gSep - 1)//gSep) - 1)*gSep + pieceLen) ≤ v < min((k + 1)*wMul, (((bits + gSep - 1)//gSep) - 1)*(gSep + 1) + pieceLen):
    CX(R + ((bits + gSep - 1)//gSep)*pieceLen + (v - (((bits + gSep - 1)//gSep) - 1)*gSep - pieceLen), addrBase + v - k*wMul)

spec geCopyFoldedWindow:
  ∀α .
    requires  0 < bits  ∧  0 < gSep  ∧  gSep ≤ pieceLen  ∧  0 < wMul
              ∧  R + regWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen) ≤ addrBase  ∧  addrBase + wMul ≤ dim
    assumes   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z) * |z⟩_q[0, dim) }}
    ensures   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z)
                 * |xorReg(z, addrBase, wMul, vwWindow(bits, gSep, pieceLen, R, wMul, k, z))⟩_q[0, dim) }}
    outcomes  none
    resource  { toffoli: 0, t: 0, rot: 0, meas: 0,

gadget gLaRunwayAt[q: dim, c: dim](w, W, bits, gSep, pieceLen, addrBase, ancBase, ppLow,
                                   ppHigh, runBase, outBase, ctrl, tOff, cb):

  unaryQROMSegCoh(w, W, addrBase, ancBase,
                  outBase, 1, gSep, pieceLen + 1,
                  ctrl, 0, tOff, cb) @ id()
  gRunwayAdd(bits, gSep, pieceLen, runBase, outBase) @ id()
  ge2021Unlookup(W, outBase, 1, gSep, pieceLen + 1,
                 w, addrBase, ppLow, ppHigh, tOff, cb + 2^w - 1) @ id()

spec gLaRunwayAt:
  ∀α .
    requires  0 < gSep  ∧  0 < pieceLen  ∧  1 < w  ∧  0 < W
              ∧  gSep ≤ pieceLen  ∧  W ≤ gSep*pieceCount(bits, gSep)
              ∧  runBase + pieceCount(bits, gSep)*pieceLen ≤ outBase
              ∧  outBase + outWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen) ≤ addrBase
              ∧  addrBase + w ≤ ancBase  ∧  ancBase + w ≤ ppLow
              ∧  ppLow + 2^halfLo(w) ≤ ppHigh
              ∧  ppHigh + 2^halfHi(w) ≤ ctrl  ∧  ctrl < dim
              ∧  ctrl < cb
              ∧  cb + measLookupAdd(w, W) ≤ dim
              ∧  (∀ a < 2^w . 0 ≤ T[tOff + a] ∧ T[tOff + a] < 2^W)
              ∧  (∀ i < W . ∀ lo < 2^halfLo(w) .
                    Tbar[tOff*(W*2^halfLo(w)) + i*2^halfLo(w) + lo]
                      = gePhaseWord(w, tOff, i, lo))
    assumes   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z)
                   * |setReg(setReg(setReg(setReg(setReg(setReg(z, outBase, outWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen), 0),
                                          ancBase, w, 0),
                                   ppLow, 2^halfLo(w), 0),
                            ppHigh, 2^halfHi(w), 0),
                     ctrl, 1, 1),
              cb, measLookupAdd(w, W), 0)⟩_q[0, dim) }}
    ensures   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z)
                   * (|setReg(setReg(setReg(setReg(setReg(setReg(z, outBase, outWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen), 0),
                                          ancBase, w, 0),
                                   ppLow, 2^halfLo(w), 0),
                            ppHigh, 2^halfHi(w), 0),
                     ctrl, 1, 1),
              runBase, pieceCount(bits, gSep)*pieceLen,
              runwayLookupAdd(bits, gSep, pieceLen, getReg(z, runBase, pieceCount(bits, gSep)*pieceLen),
                              T[tOff + getReg(z, addrBase, w)]))⟩_q[0, cb)
                      ⊗ |setReg(setReg(setReg(setReg(setReg(setReg(z, outBase, outWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen), 0),
                                          ancBase, w, 0),
                                   ppLow, 2^halfLo(w), 0),
                            ppHigh, 2^halfHi(w), 0),
                     ctrl, 1, 1),
              runBase, pieceCount(bits, gSep)*pieceLen,
              runwayLookupAdd(bits, gSep, pieceLen, getReg(z, runBase, pieceCount(bits, gSep)*pieceLen),
                              T[tOff + getReg(z, addrBase, w)]))
                           >> (cb + measLookupAdd(w, W))⟩_q[cb + measLookupAdd(w, W), dim)) }}
    outcomes  none
    resource  { toffoli: toffLookupAdd(w, bits, gSep, pieceLen),
                t: 7*toffLookupAdd(w, bits, gSep, pieceLen),
                clifford: cliffLookupAdd(w, W, bits, gSep, pieceLen, tOff),
                rot: 0,
                meas: measLookupAdd(w, W) }

gadget gRunwayAdd[q: max(runBase + (((bits + gSep - 1)//gSep))*pieceLen, outBase + (((bits + gSep - 1)//gSep))*(pieceLen + 1))](bits, gSep, pieceLen, runBase, outBase):
  for 0 ≤ p < (((bits + gSep - 1)//gSep)):
    relocAdder(pieceLen,
               runBase + p*pieceLen,
               outBase + p*(pieceLen + 1)) @ id()

spec gRunwayAdd:
  ∀α .
    requires  0 < gSep  ∧  0 < bits  ∧  0 < pieceLen
              ∧  runBase + pieceCount(bits, gSep)*pieceLen ≤ outBase
              ∧  outBase + outWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen) ≤ dim
    assumes   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z)
                   * |runwayClearWord(bits, gSep, pieceLen, outBase, z)⟩_q[0, dim) }}
    ensures   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z)
                   * |runwaySumWord(bits, gSep, pieceLen, runBase, outBase,
                        runwayClearWord(bits, gSep, pieceLen, outBase, z))⟩_q[0, dim) }}
    outcomes  none
    resource  { toffoli: toffRunwayAdd(bits, gSep, pieceLen),
                t: 7*toffRunwayAdd(bits, gSep, pieceLen),
                clifford: cliffRunwayAdd(bits, gSep, pieceLen),
                rot: 0, meas: 0,
                qubits: pieceCount(bits, gSep)*pieceLen + outWidth(bits, gSep, pieceLen) }

gadget unaryQROMSegCoh[q: dim, c: dim](d, W, addrBase, ancBase, posBase, posStride,
                                       segLen, segStride, ctrl, base, tOff, cb):
  if d ≠ 0:
    CCX(ctrl, addrBase + d - 1, ancBase + d - 1)
    unaryQROMSegCoh(d - 1, W, addrBase, ancBase, posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride,
                    ancBase + d - 1, base + 2^(d-1), tOff, cb) @ id()
    CX(ctrl, ancBase + d - 1)
    unaryQROMSegCoh(d - 1, W, addrBase, ancBase, posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride,
                    ancBase + d - 1, base, tOff, cb + 2^(d-1) - 1) @ id()
    CX(ctrl, ancBase + d - 1)

    H(ancBase + d - 1)
    measure ancBase + d - 1 ↦ c[cb + 2^d - 2]
    when c[cb + 2^d - 2]:
      H(addrBase + d - 1)
      CX(ctrl, addrBase + d - 1)
      H(addrBase + d - 1)
      X(ancBase + d - 1)
  else:
    for 0 ≤ j < W:
      if (T[tOff + base] >> W - 1 - j) % 2 = 1:
        CX(ctrl, (posBase + segStride*((W - 1 - j)//segLen) + posStride*((W - 1 - j)%segLen)))

spec unaryQROMSegCoh:
  ∀α .
    requires  0 < W  ∧  0 < segLen  ∧  0 < posStride
              ∧  addrBase + d ≤ ancBase  ∧  ancBase + d ≤ ctrl  ∧  ctrl < cb
              ∧  (∀ m < W . ∀ n < W . m ≠ n →
                    posWire(posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride, m)
                      ≠ posWire(posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride, n))
              ∧  (∀ m < W . ∀ j < d .
                    posWire(posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride, m) ≠ addrBase + j)
              ∧  (∀ m < W . ∀ j < d .
                    posWire(posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride, m) ≠ ancBase + j)
              ∧  (∀ m < W . posWire(posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride, m) ≠ ctrl)
              ∧  (∀ m < W . posWire(posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride, m) < cb)
              ∧  cb + 2^d - 1 ≤ dim
    assumes   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z)
                   * |setReg(setReg(z, ancBase, d, 0), cb, 2^d - 1, 0)⟩_q[0, dim) }}
    ensures   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z)
                   * (|posXor(W, setReg(z, ancBase, d, 0), posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride,
                              bit(z, ctrl)*T[tOff + base + getReg(z, addrBase, d)])⟩_q[0, cb)
                      ⊗ |posXor(W, setReg(z, ancBase, d, 0), posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride,
                                bit(z, ctrl)*T[tOff + base + getReg(z, addrBase, d)])
                           >> (cb + 2^d - 1)⟩_q[cb + 2^d - 1, dim)) }}
    outcomes  none
    resource  { toffoli: toffQROM(d),
                t: 7*toffQROM(d),
                clifford: cliffQROM(d, W, base, tOff),
                rot: 0,
                meas: measQROM(d) }

gadget ge2021UnlookPhaseup[q: cb, c: cb + W](W, posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride,
                                              kL, kH, ppLow, ppHigh, tOff, cb):
  for 0 ≤ i < W:
    H((posBase + segStride*(i//segLen) + posStride*(i%segLen)))
    measure (posBase + segStride*(i//segLen) + posStride*(i%segLen)) ↦ c[cb + i]
    when c[cb + i]:
      X((posBase + segStride*(i//segLen) + posStride*(i%segLen)))
  maskedPhaseParity(W, kL, kH, ppLow, ppHigh, tOff, cb) @ id()

gadget maskedPhaseParity[q: cb, c: cb + W](W, kL, kH, ppLow, ppHigh, tOff, cb):
  for 0 ≤ mL < 2^kL:
    for 0 ≤ mH < 2^kH:
      when ⊕ i < W . (c[cb + i] ∧ (Tbar[tOff*(W*2^kL) + i*2^kL + mL] >> mH) % 2 = 1):
        CZ(ppLow + mL, ppHigh + mH)

gadget ge2021Unlookup[q: cb, c: cb + W + (2^(w//2) - w//2 - 1) + (2^(w - w//2) - (w - w//2) - 1)]
                     (W, posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride,
                      w, addrBase, ppLow, ppHigh, tOff, cb):

  powerProduct((w//2), addrBase,             ppLow) @ id()
  powerProduct((w - w//2), addrBase + (w//2), ppHigh) @ id()

  ge2021UnlookPhaseup(W, posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride,
                      (w//2), (w - w//2), ppLow, ppHigh, tOff, cb) @ id()

  powerProductRelease((w//2), addrBase, ppLow, cb + W) @ id()
  powerProductRelease((w - w//2), addrBase + (w//2), ppHigh,
                      cb + W + (2^(w//2) - w//2 - 1)) @ id()

gadget powerProduct[q: ppBase + 2^k](k, addrBase, ppBase):
  X(ppBase)
  CX(addrBase, ppBase + 1)
  for 1 ≤ i < k:
    CX(addrBase + i, ppBase + 2^i)
    for 1 ≤ S < 2^i:
      CCX(ppBase + S, addrBase + i, ppBase + S + 2^i)

gadget powerProductRelease[q: ppBase + 2^k, c: cb + 2^k - k - 1](k, addrBase, ppBase, cb):
  for 0 ≤ i < k:
    for 1 ≤ S < 2^(k - 1 - i):
      H(ppBase + S + 2^(k - 1 - i))
      measure ppBase + S + 2^(k - 1 - i) ↦ c[cb + (2^i - 1)*2^(k - i) - i + (S - 1)]
      when c[cb + (2^i - 1)*2^(k - i) - i + (S - 1)]:
        CZ(ppBase + S, addrBase + k - 1 - i)
        X(ppBase + S + 2^(k - 1 - i))
  for 0 ≤ i < k:
    CX(addrBase + i, ppBase + 2^i)
  X(ppBase)

spec ge2021UnlookPhaseup:
  ∀ i < W . ∀α .
    requires  0 < W  ∧  0 < segLen  ∧  0 < posStride
              ∧  (∀ m < W . ∀ n < W . m ≠ n →
                    posWire(posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride, m)
                      ≠ posWire(posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride, n))
              ∧  (∀ m < W . ∀ S < 2^kL .
                    posWire(posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride, m) ≠ ppLow + S)
              ∧  (∀ m < W . ∀ S < 2^kH .
                    posWire(posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride, m) ≠ ppHigh + S)
              ∧  (∀ m < W . posWire(posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride, m) < dim)
              ∧  ppLow + 2^kL ≤ ppHigh
              ∧  ppHigh + 2^kH ≤ dim
              ∧  ppHigh + 2^kH ≤ cb
              ∧  (∀ m < W . posWire(posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride, m) < cb)
              ∧  cb + W ≤ dim
    assumes   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z)
                   * |posSet(W, setReg(z, cb, W, 0), posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride,
                             phaseBits(W, kL, kH, ppLow, ppHigh, tOff, z))⟩_q[0, dim) }}
    ensures   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z)
                   * (|posSet(W, z, posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride, 0)⟩_q[0, cb)
                      ⊗ |posSet(W, z, posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride, 0) >> (cb + W)⟩_q[cb + W,
                                                                                            dim)) }}
    outcomes  Pr[ c[i] = 1 ]  =  1/2
    resource  { toffoli: 0,
                t: 0,
                clifford: 2*W + 3*2^kL*2^kH,
                rot: 0,
                meas: W }

spec ge2021Unlookup:
  ∀ i < W . ∀α .
    requires  0 < W  ∧  1 < w  ∧  0 < segLen  ∧  0 < posStride
              ∧  (∀ u < W . ∀ v < W . u ≠ v →
                    posWire(posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride, u)
                      ≠ posWire(posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride, v))
              ∧  (∀ u < W . ∀ S < 2^halfLo(w) .
                    posWire(posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride, u) ≠ ppLow + S)
              ∧  (∀ u < W . ∀ S < 2^halfHi(w) .
                    posWire(posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride, u) ≠ ppHigh + S)
              ∧  (∀ u < W . ∀ j < w .
                    posWire(posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride, u) ≠ addrBase + j)
              ∧  (∀ u < W . posWire(posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride, u) < dim)
              ∧  addrBase + w ≤ ppLow  ∧  ppLow + 2^halfLo(w) ≤ ppHigh
              ∧  ppHigh + 2^halfHi(w) ≤ dim
              ∧  ppHigh + 2^halfHi(w) ≤ cb
              ∧  (∀ u < W . posWire(posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride, u) < cb)
              ∧  cb + W + (2^halfLo(w) - halfLo(w) - 1)
                      + (2^halfHi(w) - halfHi(w) - 1) ≤ dim
              ∧  (∀ i < W . ∀ lo < 2^halfLo(w) .
                    Tbar[tOff*(W*2^halfLo(w)) + i*2^halfLo(w) + lo]
                      = gePhaseWord(w, tOff, i, lo))
    assumes   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z)
                   * |posSet(W, setReg(setReg(setReg(z, ppLow, 2^halfLo(w), 0),
                                              ppHigh, 2^halfHi(w), 0),
                                       cb, W + (2^halfLo(w) - halfLo(w) - 1)
                                             + (2^halfHi(w) - halfHi(w) - 1), 0),
                             posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride,
                             T[tOff + getReg(z, addrBase, w)])⟩_q[0, dim) }}
    ensures   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z)
                   * (|posSet(W, setReg(setReg(z, ppLow, 2^halfLo(w), 0), ppHigh, 2^halfHi(w), 0),
                             posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride, 0)⟩_q[0, cb)
                      ⊗ |posSet(W, setReg(setReg(z, ppLow, 2^halfLo(w), 0), ppHigh, 2^halfHi(w), 0),
                                posBase, posStride, segLen, segStride, 0)
                           >> (cb + W + (2^halfLo(w) - halfLo(w) - 1)
                                 + (2^halfHi(w) - halfHi(w) - 1))⟩_q[cb + W
                                   + (2^halfLo(w) - halfLo(w) - 1)
                                   + (2^halfHi(w) - halfHi(w) - 1), dim)) }}
    outcomes  Pr[ c[i] = 1 ]  =  1/2
    resource  { toffoli: toffPhaseup(w),
                t: 7*toffPhaseup(w),
                clifford: cliffUnlookup(W, w, tOff),
                rot: 0,
                meas: measUnlookup(W, w) }

spec powerProduct:
  ∀α .
    requires  0 < k  ∧  addrBase + k ≤ ppBase  ∧  ppBase + 2^k ≤ dim
    assumes   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z) * |setReg(z, ppBase, 2^k, 0)⟩_q[0, dim) }}
    ensures   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z)
                   * |setReg(z, ppBase, 2^k, ppWord(k, getReg(z, addrBase, k)))⟩_q[0, dim) }}
    outcomes  none
    resource  { toffoli: toffPP(k),
                t: 7*toffPP(k),
                clifford: cliffPP(k),
                rot: 0, meas: 0 }

spec powerProductRelease:
  ∀α .
    requires  addrBase + k ≤ ppBase  ∧  ppBase + 2^k ≤ dim
              ∧  ppBase + 2^k ≤ cb
              ∧  cb + (2^k - k - 1) ≤ dim
    assumes   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z)
                   * |setReg(setReg(z, ppBase, 2^k, ppWord(k, getReg(z, addrBase, k))),
                             cb, 2^k - k - 1, 0)⟩_q[0, dim) }}
    ensures   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z)
                   * (|setReg(z, ppBase, 2^k, 0)⟩_q[0, cb)
                      ⊗ |setReg(z, ppBase, 2^k, 0) >> (cb + (2^k - k - 1))⟩_q[cb + (2^k - k - 1),
                                                                             dim)) }}
    outcomes  none
    resource  { toffoli: 0, t: 0,
                clifford: cliffPPRelease(k),
                rot: 0, meas: measPPRelease(k) }

spec maskedPhaseParity:
  ∀ r < 2^W . ∀α .
    requires  ppLow + 2^kL ≤ ppHigh  ∧  ppHigh + 2^kH ≤ cb  ∧  cb + W ≤ dim
    assumes   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z) * |setReg(z, cb, W, r)⟩_q[0, dim) }}
    ensures   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z)
                   * ((-1)^(parityPhase(W, kL, kH, ppLow, ppHigh, tOff, r, z))
                      * |setReg(z, cb, W, r)⟩_q[0, dim)) }}
    outcomes  none
    resource  { toffoli: 0, t: 0, clifford: 3*2^kL*2^kH, rot: 0, meas: 0 }

gadget gIdealIQFT[q: expWire + nE](expWire, nE, nA):
  for 0 ≤ p < nE:
    gIdealIQFTRead(1, expWire, p, nA) @ id()

gadget gIdealIQFTRead[q: expWire + (m + 1)*wExp](wExp, expWire, m, nA):
  for 0 ≤ i < wExp:
    for (m*wExp//nA)*nA ≤ u < m*wExp + i:
      ctrl expWire + u:
        Rz(expWire + m*wExp + i, m*wExp + i - u)
    H(expWire + m*wExp + i)

gadget gExpAllMeasure[q: expWire + numMults*wExp, c: cb + numMults*wExp]
                     (wExp, expWire, numMults, cb):
  for 0 ≤ g < numMults*wExp:

gadget gLoop1[q: top, c: cb + W1*(2^w1 - w1 + 2*D - 2)](W1, w1, m, D, expBase, dlogBase, addrBase, ppBase, tOff, cb):
  for 0 ≤ j < W1:
    cxCascade(min(w1, m - j*w1), 1, expBase+j*w1, 1, addrBase) @ id()
    powerProduct(w1, addrBase, ppBase) @ id()
    for 0 ≤ S < 2^w1:
      for 0 ≤ jOut < D:
        if (Tanf[tOff + j*2^w1 + S] >> jOut) % 2 = 1:
          CX(ppBase+S, dlogBase + 3*jOut)
    gidneyAddNoCarry(D, cb + j*(2^w1 - w1 + 2*D - 2)) @ shift(dlogBase)
    mxDescending(D, dlogBase, 3, cb + j*(2^w1 - w1 + 2*D - 2) + D - 1) @ id()
    for 0 ≤ b < D:
      when c[cb + j*(2^w1 - w1 + 2*D - 2) + D - 1 + b]:
        for 0 ≤ S < 2^w1:
          if (Tanf[tOff + j*2^w1 + S] >> b) % 2 = 1:
            Z(ppBase+S)
    powerProductRelease(w1, addrBase, ppBase, cb + j*(2^w1 - w1 + 2*D - 2) + 2*D - 1) @ id()
    cxCascade(min(w1, m - j*w1), 1, expBase+j*w1, 1, addrBase) @ id()

                 ∧ expBase + m ≤ dlogBase ∧ dlogBase + 3*D ≤ addrBase
                 ∧ addrBase + w1 ≤ ppBase ∧ ppBase + 2^w1 ≤ dim

                 ∧ ppBase + 2^w1 ≤ cb
                 ∧ (∀ j < W1 . ∀ addr < 2^w1 .
