                      ⊗ |z >> (dlogBase+3*(D+2))⟩_q[dlogBase+3*(D+2), cb)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[cb, cb+(D-cl)*(D+cl-2))
                      ⊗ |z >> (cb+(D-cl)*(D+cl-2))⟩_q[cb+(D-cl)*(D+cl-2), dim) )) }}
    ensures      {{ Σ z < 2^dim . (Σ x0 < modulus * 2^(D-cl) . α(z + 2^dim*x0) * (
                      |z⟩_q[0, dlogBase)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[dlogBase, dlogBase+3*(D+2) : 3)
                      ⊗ |pyLoop2(D, cl, modulus, x0)⟩_q[dlogBase+1, dlogBase+3*(D+2)+1 : 3)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[dlogBase+2, dlogBase+3*(D+2)+2 : 3)
                      ⊗ |z >> (dlogBase+3*(D+2))⟩_q[dlogBase+3*(D+2), cb)
                      ⊗ |z >> (cb+(D-cl)*(D+cl-2))⟩_q[cb+(D-cl)*(D+cl-2), dim) )) }}
    outcomes     none
    resource     { toffoli:  toffL2(D, cl),
                   t:        7*toffL2(D, cl),
                   rot:      0,
                   meas:     toffL2(D, cl),
                   clifford: cliffL2(D, cl, modulus) }

gadget gUnloop2Step[q: dlogBase + 3*(n+2), c: cb + 2*n - 1](n, cl, modulus, dlogBase, cb):
  conditionalAddPNC(n, 3*n+1, 2^n - modulus*2^(n-cl), cb) @ shift(dlogBase)
  addConstNoCarry(n+1, modulus*2^(n-cl), cb + (n-1)) @ shift(dlogBase)

spec gUnloop2Step:
  ∀α .
    requires     2 ≤ n ∧ cl ≤ n ∧ modulus < 2^cl
                 ∧ dlogBase + 3*(n+2) ≤ cb
                 ∧ cb + 2*n - 1 ≤ dim
    assumes      {{ Σ z < 2^dim . (Σ x < 2^(n+2) . α(z + 2^dim*x) * (
                      |z⟩_q[0, dlogBase)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[dlogBase, dlogBase+3*(n+2) : 3)
                      ⊗ |x⟩_q[dlogBase+1, dlogBase+3*(n+2)+1 : 3)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[dlogBase+2, dlogBase+3*(n+2)+2 : 3)
                      ⊗ |z >> (dlogBase+3*(n+2))⟩_q[dlogBase+3*(n+2), cb)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[cb, cb+2*n-1)
                      ⊗ |z >> (cb+2*n-1)⟩_q[cb+2*n-1, dim) )) }}
    ensures      {{ Σ z < 2^dim . (Σ x < 2^(n+2) . α(z + 2^dim*x) * (
                      |z⟩_q[0, dlogBase)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[dlogBase, dlogBase+3*(n+2) : 3)
                      ⊗ |unloop2Step(cl, modulus, x, n)⟩_q[dlogBase+1, dlogBase+3*(n+2)+1 : 3)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[dlogBase+2, dlogBase+3*(n+2)+2 : 3)
                      ⊗ |z >> (dlogBase+3*(n+2))⟩_q[dlogBase+3*(n+2), cb)
                      ⊗ |z >> (cb+2*n-1)⟩_q[cb+2*n-1, dim) )) }}
    outcomes     none
    resource     { toffoli:  2*n - 1,
                   t:        14*n - 7,
                   rot:      0,
                   meas:     2*n - 1,
                   clifford: cliffU2Step(n, cl, modulus) }

gadget gUnloop2[q: dlogBase + 3*(D+2), c: cb + (D-cl)*(D+cl-2)](D, cl, modulus, dlogBase, cb):
  for 0 ≤ u < D - cl:
    gUnloop2Step(cl+u, cl, modulus, dlogBase, cb + u*(2*cl+u-2)) @ id()


spec gUnloop2:
  ∀α .
    requires     2 ≤ cl ∧ cl ≤ D ∧ modulus < 2^cl
                 ∧ cb + (D-cl)*(D+cl-2) ≤ dim
                 ∧ dlogBase + 3*(D+2) ≤ cb
    assumes      {{ Σ z < 2^dim . (Σ x0 < 2^D . α(z + 2^dim*x0) * (
                      |z⟩_q[0, dlogBase)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[dlogBase, dlogBase+3*(D+2) : 3)
                      ⊗ |pyLoop2(D, cl, modulus, x0)⟩_q[dlogBase+1, dlogBase+3*(D+2)+1 : 3)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[dlogBase+2, dlogBase+3*(D+2)+2 : 3)
                      ⊗ |z >> (dlogBase+3*(D+2))⟩_q[dlogBase+3*(D+2), cb)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[cb, cb+(D-cl)*(D+cl-2))
                      ⊗ |z >> (cb+(D-cl)*(D+cl-2))⟩_q[cb+(D-cl)*(D+cl-2), dim) )) }}
    ensures      {{ Σ z < 2^dim . (Σ x0 < 2^D . α(z + 2^dim*x0) * (
                      |z⟩_q[0, dlogBase)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[dlogBase, dlogBase+3*(D+2) : 3)
                      ⊗ |x0⟩_q[dlogBase+1, dlogBase+3*(D+2)+1 : 3)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[dlogBase+2, dlogBase+3*(D+2)+2 : 3)
                      ⊗ |z >> (dlogBase+3*(D+2))⟩_q[dlogBase+3*(D+2), cb)
                      ⊗ |z >> (cb+(D-cl)*(D+cl-2))⟩_q[cb+(D-cl)*(D+cl-2), dim) )) }}
    outcomes     none
    resource     { toffoli:  toffU2(D, cl),
                   t:        7*toffU2(D, cl),
                   rot:      0,
                   meas:     toffU2(D, cl),
                   clifford: cliffU2(D, cl, modulus) }

gadget gLoop3Step[q: top,
                  c: max(cb + 2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 + 3*ell, rslot + 1)]
                 (w3, ell, modulus, dlogBase, resBase, addrBase,
                  ppBase, helpBase, j, k, tOff, rslot, cb):
  cxCascade(w3, 3, dlogBase+3*(j*w3)+1, 1, addrBase+w3) @ id()
  cxCascade(w3, 3, resBase+3*(k*w3)+1, 1, addrBase) @ id()
  powerProduct(2*w3, addrBase, ppBase) @ id()
  for 0 ≤ S < 2^(2*w3):
    for 0 ≤ jOut < ell+1:
      if (Tanf[tOff + S] >> jOut) % 2 = 1:
        CX(ppBase+S, helpBase + 3*jOut)
  gidneyModAddSub(ell, cb) @ shift(helpBase)

  mxDescending(ell+1, helpBase, 3, cb + ell) @ id()
  for 0 ≤ b < ell+1:
    when c[cb + ell + b]:
      for 0 ≤ S < 2^(2*w3):
        if (Tanf[tOff + S] >> b) % 2 = 1:
          Z(ppBase+S)
  powerProductRelease(2*w3, addrBase, ppBase, cb + 2*ell + 1) @ id()
  gidneyModAddBackRec(ell, modulus,
                      rslot - (cb + 2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 + 2*ell),
                      cb + 2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 + 2*ell) @ shift(helpBase)
  cxCascade(w3, 3, resBase+3*(k*w3)+1, 1, addrBase) @ id()
  cxCascade(w3, 3, dlogBase+3*(j*w3)+1, 1, addrBase+w3) @ id()

spec gLoop3Step:
  ∀ m < 2 . ∀α .
    requires     2 ≤ ell ∧ 0 < w3 ∧ 2 ≤ modulus ∧ 2 ≤ j ∧ j < W3a ∧ k < W3b
                 ∧ cb + 2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 + 3*ell ≤ rslot
                 ∧ dlogBase ≤ helpBase ∧ helpBase + 3*(ell+2) ≤ addrBase
                 ∧ addrBase + 2*w3 ≤ ppBase
                 ∧ ppBase + 2^(2*w3) ≤ dim
                 ∧ ppBase + 2^(2*w3) ≤ cb
                 ∧ cb + 2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 + 3*ell ≤ recTop ∧ rslot < recTop ∧ recTop ≤ dim
                 ∧ dlogBase + 3*((j+1)*w3) ≤ resBase
                 ∧ resBase + 3*((k+1)*w3) ≤ helpBase
                 ∧ top ≤ rslot
    assumes {{ (Σ z < 2^dim . (Σ addr < 2^(2*w3) . (Σ x < 2^w3 . (Σ y < 2^w3 . (Σ b < 2^(ell+1) . α(z + 2^dim*(addr + 2^(2*w3)*(x + 2^w3*(y + 2^w3*b)))) * (
      |z⟩_q[0, dim)
      ⊗ |x⟩_q[dlogBase+3*(j*w3)+1, dlogBase+3*((j+1)*w3)+1 : 3)
      ⊗ |y⟩_q[resBase+3*(k*w3)+1, resBase+3*((k+1)*w3)+1 : 3)
      ⊗ |addr⟩_q[addrBase, addrBase+2*w3)
      ⊗ |0⟩_q[ppBase, ppBase+2^(2*w3))
      ⊗ |0⟩_q[helpBase, helpBase+3*(ell+1) : 3)
      ⊗ |b⟩_q[helpBase+1, helpBase+3*(ell+1)+1 : 3)
      ⊗ |0⟩_q[helpBase+2, helpBase+3*(ell+1)+2 : 3)
      ⊗ |0⟩_q[helpBase+3*(ell+1)+2]
      ⊗ |0⟩_q[cb, cb+2^(2*w3)-2*w3+3*ell)
      ⊗ |0⟩_q[rslot] )))))) }}
    ensures {{ sqrt(1/2) * (Σ z < 2^dim . (Σ addr < 2^(2*w3) . (Σ x < 2^w3 . (Σ y < 2^w3 . (Σ b < 2^(ell+1) . α(z + 2^dim*(addr + 2^(2*w3)*(x + 2^w3*(y + 2^w3*b)))) * (-1)^(m*bit((b + lookupVal(2*w3, ell+1, tOff, bitXor(2*w3, addr, y+2^w3*x))) % 2^(ell+1), ell)) * (
      |z⟩_q[0, cb)
      ⊗ |z >> (cb+2^(2*w3)-2*w3+3*ell)⟩_q[cb+2^(2*w3)-2*w3+3*ell, dim)
      ⊗ |x⟩_q[dlogBase+3*(j*w3)+1, dlogBase+3*((j+1)*w3)+1 : 3)
      ⊗ |y⟩_q[resBase+3*(k*w3)+1, resBase+3*((k+1)*w3)+1 : 3)
      ⊗ |addr⟩_q[addrBase, addrBase+2*w3)
      ⊗ |0⟩_q[ppBase, ppBase+2^(2*w3))
      ⊗ |0⟩_q[helpBase, helpBase+3*(ell+1) : 3)
      ⊗ |modAddBackVal(ell, modulus, (b + lookupVal(2*w3, ell+1, tOff, bitXor(2*w3, addr, y+2^w3*x))) % 2^(ell+1))⟩_q[helpBase+1, helpBase+3*(ell+1)+1 : 3)
      ⊗ |0⟩_q[helpBase+2, helpBase+3*(ell+1)+2 : 3)
      ⊗ |0⟩_q[helpBase+3*(ell+1)+2]
      ⊗ |m⟩_q[rslot] )))))) }}
    given c[rslot-top, rslot+1-top) = m
    outcomes none
    resource     { toffoli:  toffL3Step(w3, ell),
                   t:        7*toffL3Step(w3, ell),
                   rot:      0,
                   meas:     measL3Step(w3, ell),
                   clifford: cliffL3Step(w3, ell, modulus, tOff) }

gadget gLoop3[q: top,
              c: max(cb + 2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 - 1
                        + (W3a-2)*(W3b*(2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 + 3*ell) + ell + 1) + ell + 1,
                     recBase + (W3a-2)*W3b)]
             (w3, W3a, W3b, ell, modulus, dlogBase, resBase,
              addrBase, ppBase, helpBase, tOff, recBase, cb):

  cxCascade(2*w3, 3, dlogBase+1, 1, addrBase) @ id()
  lookupPP(2*w3, ell+1, addrBase, ppBase, resBase+1, 3, tOff, cb) @ id()
  cxCascade(2*w3, 3, dlogBase+1, 1, addrBase) @ id()
  for 2 ≤ j < W3a:
    for 0 ≤ k < W3b:
      gLoop3Step(w3, ell, modulus, dlogBase, resBase, addrBase, ppBase, helpBase, j, k,
                 tOff + 2^(2*w3) + (j*W3b+k)*2^(2*w3),
                 recBase + (j-2)*W3b + k,
                 cb + 2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 - 1
                    + (j-2)*(W3b*(2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 + 3*ell) + ell + 1)
                    + k*(2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 + 3*ell)) @ id()

    accYSwapG(ell+1, resBase+1, 3, helpBase+1, 3) @ id()

    mxDescending(ell+1, helpBase+1, 3,
                 cb + 2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 - 1
                    + (j-2)*(W3b*(2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 + 3*ell) + ell + 1)
                    + W3b*(2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 + 3*ell)) @ id()

  mzDescending(ell+1, helpBase+1, 3,
               cb + 2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 - 1
                  + (W3a-2)*(W3b*(2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 + 3*ell) + ell + 1)) @ id()

spec gLoop3:
  ∀ i < P . ∀ rec < 2^((W3a-2)*(W3b+ell+1)) . ∀α .
    requires     2 ≤ W3a ∧ 2 ≤ ell ∧ 0 < w3 ∧ ell ≤ W3b*w3 ∧ 0 < W3b
                 ∧ modulus = pAt(i) ∧ pAt(i) ≤ 2^ell ∧ tOff = i*primeStride + offL3c
                 ∧ dlogBase + 3*(D+2) ≤ resBase ∧ resBase + 3*(ell+2) ≤ helpBase
                 ∧ helpBase + 3*(ell+2) ≤ addrBase ∧ addrBase + 2*w3 ≤ ppBase
                 ∧ ppBase + 2^(2*w3) ≤ dim
                 ∧ ppBase + 2^(2*w3) ≤ cb
                 ∧ cb + 2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 - 1
                     + (W3a-2)*(W3b*(2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 + 3*ell) + ell + 1) + ell + 1 ≤ recTop
                 ∧ recBase + (W3a-2)*W3b ≤ recTop ∧ recTop ≤ dim
                 ∧ W3a*w3 ≤ D ∧ resBase + 3*(W3b*w3) ≤ helpBase ∧ 2 ≤ modulus
                 ∧ cb + 2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 - 1
                     + (W3a-2)*(W3b*(2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 + 3*ell) + ell + 1) + ell + 1 ≤ recBase
                 ∧ (∀ addr < 2^(2*w3) .
                      lookupVal(2*w3, ell+1, tOff, addr) = lookup3cVal(i, addr))
                 ∧ (∀ u < W3a-2 . ∀ k < W3b . ∀ addr < 2^(2*w3) .
                      lookupVal(2*w3, ell+1,
                        tOff + 2^(2*w3) + ((u+2)*W3b+k)*2^(2*w3), addr)
                      = (2^(ell+1) - ((modulus - lookup3aVal(w3, i, u+2, k, addr)) % modulus))
                          % 2^(ell+1))
                 ∧ top ≤ cb
    assumes      {{ Σ z < 2^dim . (Σ dlog < 2^(W3a*w3) . α(z + 2^dim*dlog) * (
                      |z⟩_q[0, dim)
                      ⊗ |dlog⟩_q[dlogBase+1, dlogBase+3*(W3a*w3)+1 : 3)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[resBase, helpBase)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[helpBase, addrBase)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[addrBase, addrBase+2*w3)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[ppBase, ppBase+2^(2*w3))
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[cb, cb + (2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 - 1 + (W3a-2)*(W3b*(2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 + 3*ell) + ell + 1) + ell + 1))
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[recBase, recBase+(W3a-2)*W3b) )) }}
    ensures      {{ Σ z < 2^dim . (Σ dlog < 2^(W3a*w3) . (α(z + 2^dim*dlog) * (-1)^(l3Phase(rec, w3, W3a, W3b, ell, i, dlog)) / sqrt(2^((W3a-2)*(W3b+ell+1)))) * (
                      |z⟩_q[0, cb)
                      ⊗ |z >> (cb + (2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 - 1 + (W3a-2)*(W3b*(2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 + 3*ell) + ell + 1) + ell + 1))⟩_q[cb + (2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 - 1 + (W3a-2)*(W3b*(2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 + 3*ell) + ell + 1) + ell + 1), dim)
                      ⊗ |dlog⟩_q[dlogBase+1, dlogBase+3*(W3a*w3)+1 : 3)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[resBase, resBase+3*(ell+1) : 3)
                      ⊗ |pyLoop3(w3, W3a, W3b, i, dlog)⟩_q[resBase+1, resBase+3*(ell+1)+1 : 3)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[resBase+2, resBase+3*(ell+1)+2 : 3)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[resBase+3*(ell+1), helpBase)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[helpBase, addrBase)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[addrBase, addrBase+2*w3)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[ppBase, ppBase+2^(2*w3))
                      ⊗ |rec⟩_q[map t < (W3a-2)*(W3b+ell+1) . l3RecPos(t, w3, W3a, W3b, ell, recBase, cb)]
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[cb + 2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 - 1 + (W3a-2)*(W3b*(2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 + 3*ell) + ell + 1), cb + 2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 - 1 + (W3a-2)*(W3b*(2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 + 3*ell) + ell + 1) + ell + 1) )) }}
    given c[map t < (W3a-2)*(W3b+ell+1) . l3RecPos(t, w3, W3a, W3b, ell, recBase, cb) - top] = rec
    outcomes     none
    resource     { toffoli:  toffL3(w3, W3a, W3b, ell),
                   t:        7*toffL3(w3, W3a, W3b, ell),
                   rot:      0,
                   meas:     measL3(w3, W3a, W3b, ell),
                   clifford: cliffL3(w3, W3a, W3b, ell, modulus, tOff) }

gadget gLoop4Step[q: top,
                  c: cb + 2*(2^w4 - w4) + 5*f + 2^(w4 // 2) + 2^(w4 - w4 // 2) - w4]
                 (w4, f, trunc, resBase, accBase, addrBase, ppBase, j, tOff, cb):
  cxCascade(w4, 3, resBase+3*(j*w4)+1, 1, addrBase) @ id()
  lookupPP(w4, f+1, addrBase, ppBase, accBase, 3, tOff, cb) @ id()
  gidneyModAddSub(f, cb + 2^w4 - w4 - 1) @ shift(accBase)
  mxDescending(f+1, accBase, 3, cb + 2^w4 - w4 - 1 + f) @ id()
  CX(accBase+3*f+1, accBase+3*(f+1)+2)
  conditionalAddPNC(f+1, 3*(f+1)+2, trunc, cb + 2^w4 - w4 + 2*f) @ shift(accBase)
  H(accBase+3*(f+1)+2)
  measure (accBase+3*(f+1)+2) ↦ c[cb + 2^w4 - w4 + 2*f + f]
  when c[cb + 2^w4 - w4 + 2*f + f]:
    X(accBase+3*(f+1)+2)

  when c[cb + 2^w4 - w4 + 2*f + f]:
    lookupPP(w4, f+1, addrBase, ppBase, accBase, 3, tOff + 2^w4,
             cb + 2^w4 - w4 + 3*f + 1) @ id()
    gidneyCompare(f+1, cb + 2*(2^w4 - w4) + 3*f) @ shift(accBase)
    mxDescending(f+1, accBase, 3, cb + 2*(2^w4 - w4) + 4*f + 1) @ id()
  powerProduct(w4 // 2, addrBase, ppBase) @ id()
  powerProduct(w4 - w4 // 2, addrBase + w4 // 2, ppBase + 2^(w4 // 2)) @ id()
  for 0 ≤ mL < 2^(w4 // 2):
    for 0 ≤ mH < 2^(w4 - w4 // 2):
      when ⊕ i < f+1 . (c[cb + 2^w4 - w4 - 1 + f + i] ∧ (Tbar[tOff*4096 + i*2^(w4 // 2) + mL] >> mH) % 2 = 1):
        CZ(ppBase + mL, ppBase + 2^(w4 // 2) + mH)
  for 0 ≤ mL < 2^(w4 // 2):
    for 0 ≤ mH < 2^(w4 - w4 // 2):
      when ⊕ i < f+1 . (c[cb + 2*(2^w4 - w4) + 4*f + 1 + i] ∧ (Tbar[(tOff + 2^w4)*4096 + i*2^(w4 // 2) + mL] >> mH) % 2 = 1):
        CZ(ppBase + mL, ppBase + 2^(w4 // 2) + mH)
  powerProductRelease(w4 // 2, addrBase, ppBase,
                      cb + 2*(2^w4 - w4) + 5*f + 2) @ id()
  powerProductRelease(w4 - w4 // 2, addrBase + w4 // 2, ppBase + 2^(w4 // 2),
                      cb + 2*(2^w4 - w4) + 5*f + 2 + 2^(w4 // 2) - w4 // 2 - 1) @ id()
  cxCascade(w4, 3, resBase+3*(j*w4)+1, 1, addrBase) @ id()

spec gLoop4Step:
  ∀ i < P . ∀α .
    requires     ((∀ addr < 2^w4 .
                    lookupVal(w4, f+1, tOff, addr)
                    = (2^(f+1) - ((trunc - lookup4Val(w4, i, j, addr)) % trunc)) % 2^(f+1))
                 ∧ (∀ cube < 2 . ∀ b < f+1 . ∀ mL < 2^(w4 // 2) . ∀ mH < 2^(w4 - w4 // 2) .
                      bit(Tbar[(tOff + cube*2^w4)*4096 + b*2^(w4 // 2) + mL], mH)
                      = bit(Tanf[(tOff + cube*2^w4) + mL + 2^(w4 // 2)*mH], b))
                 ∧ (∀ addr < 2^w4 .
                      lookupVal(w4, f+1, tOff + 2^w4, addr)
                      = 2^(f+1) - (trunc -
                          (trunc - lookup4Val(w4, i, j, addr)) % trunc)))
                 ∧ 2 ≤ w4 ∧ 1 ≤ f ∧ 0 < trunc ∧ trunc ≤ 2^f ∧ ell + 1 ≤ W4*w4 ∧ j < W4
                 ∧ tOff = i*primeStride + offL4 + j*2*2^w4
                 ∧ Mtrunc(modN, shT) ≤ trunc
                 ∧ accBase + 3*(f+2) ≤ resBase ∧ resBase + 3*(ell+2) ≤ addrBase
                 ∧ addrBase + w4 ≤ ppBase ∧ ppBase + 2^w4 ≤ dim
                 ∧ cb + 2*(2^w4 - w4) + 5*f + 2^(w4 // 2) + 2^(w4 - w4 // 2) - w4 ≤ recTop
                 ∧ resBase + 3*(ell+1) + 1 ≤ top ∧ ppBase + 2^w4 ≤ top ∧ top ≤ cb
                 ∧ recTop ≤ dim
                 ∧ resBase + 3*(W4*w4) ≤ addrBase
    assumes      {{ Σ z < 2^dim . Σ res < 2^(ell+1) . Σ acc < trunc .
                    α(z + 2^dim*(res + 2^(ell+1)*acc)) * (
                    |z⟩_q[0, dim) ⊗ |0⟩_q[addrBase, addrBase+w4) ⊗ |0⟩_q[ppBase, ppBase+2^w4)
                    ⊗ |acc⟩_q[accBase+1, accBase+3*(f+1)+1 : 3)
                    ⊗ |res⟩_q[resBase+1, resBase+3*(W4*w4)+1 : 3)
                     ⊗ |0⟩_q[accBase, accBase+3*(f+1) : 3)
                     ⊗ |0⟩_q[accBase+2, accBase+3*(f+2)+2 : 3)
                     ⊗ |0⟩_q[cb, cb + (2*(2^w4 - w4) + 5*f + 2^(w4 // 2) + 2^(w4 - w4 // 2) - w4))) }}
    ensures      {{ Σ z < 2^dim . Σ res < 2^(ell+1) . Σ acc < trunc .
                    α(z + 2^dim*(res + 2^(ell+1)*acc)) * (
                    |z⟩_q[0, cb)
                    ⊗ |z >> (cb + (2*(2^w4 - w4) + 5*f + 2^(w4 // 2) + 2^(w4 - w4 // 2) - w4))⟩_q[cb + (2*(2^w4 - w4) + 5*f + 2^(w4 // 2) + 2^(w4 - w4 // 2) - w4), dim)
                    ⊗ |(acc + lookup4Val(w4, i, j, (res >> j*w4) % 2^w4)) % trunc⟩_q[accBase+1, accBase+3*(f+1)+1 : 3)
                    ⊗ |res⟩_q[resBase+1, resBase+3*(W4*w4)+1 : 3)
                    ⊗ |0⟩_q[accBase, accBase+3*(f+1) : 3)
                    ⊗ |0⟩_q[addrBase, addrBase+w4)
                    ⊗ |0⟩_q[ppBase, ppBase+2^w4)
                     ⊗ |0⟩_q[accBase+2, accBase+3*(f+2)+2 : 3)) }}
    outcomes     none
    resource     { toffoli:  toffL4Step(w4, f),
                   t:        7*toffL4Step(w4, f),

                   meas:     measL4Step(w4, f),

gadget gLoop4[q: top,
              c: cb + W4*(2*(2^w4 - w4) + 5*f + 2^(w4 // 2) + 2^(w4 - w4 // 2) - w4)]
             (w4, W4, f, trunc, resBase, accBase, addrBase, ppBase, tOff, cb):
  for 0 ≤ j < W4:
    gLoop4Step(w4, f, trunc, resBase, accBase, addrBase, ppBase, j,
               tOff + j*2*2^w4,
               cb + j*(2*(2^w4 - w4) + 5*f + 2^(w4 // 2) + 2^(w4 - w4 // 2) - w4)) @ id()

spec gLoop4:
  ∀ i < P . ∀α .
    requires     ((∀ j < W4 . ∀ addr < 2^w4 .
                    lookupVal(w4, f+1, tOff + j*2*2^w4, addr)
                    = (2^(f+1) - ((trunc - lookup4Val(w4, i, j, addr)) % trunc)) % 2^(f+1))
                 ∧ (∀ j < W4 . ∀ cube < 2 . ∀ b < f+1 . ∀ mL < 2^(w4 // 2) . ∀ mH < 2^(w4 - w4 // 2) .
                      bit(Tbar[(tOff + j*2*2^w4 + cube*2^w4)*4096 + b*2^(w4 // 2) + mL], mH)
                      = bit(Tanf[(tOff + j*2*2^w4 + cube*2^w4) + mL + 2^(w4 // 2)*mH], b))
                 ∧ (∀ j < W4 . ∀ addr < 2^w4 .
                      lookupVal(w4, f+1, tOff + j*2*2^w4 + 2^w4, addr)
                      = 2^(f+1) - (trunc -
                          (trunc - lookup4Val(w4, i, j, addr)) % trunc)))
                 ∧ 2 ≤ w4 ∧ 1 ≤ f ∧ ell + 1 ≤ W4*w4 ∧ trunc ≤ 2^f
                 ∧ tOff = i*primeStride + offL4
                 ∧ Mtrunc(modN, shT) ≤ trunc
                 ∧ accBase + 3*(f+2) ≤ resBase ∧ resBase + 3*(ell+2) ≤ addrBase
                 ∧ addrBase + w4 ≤ ppBase ∧ ppBase + 2^w4 ≤ dim
                 ∧ cb + W4*(2*(2^w4 - w4) + 5*f + 2^(w4 // 2) + 2^(w4 - w4 // 2) - w4) ≤ recTop
                 ∧ ppBase + 2^w4 ≤ top ∧ top ≤ cb
                 ∧ recTop ≤ dim
                 ∧ resBase + 3*(W4*w4) ≤ addrBase
    assumes      {{ Σ z < 2^dim . Σ res < 2^(ell+1) . Σ acc0 < trunc .
                    α(z + 2^dim*(res + 2^(ell+1)*acc0)) * (
                    |z⟩_q[0, dim) ⊗ |0⟩_q[addrBase, addrBase+w4) ⊗ |0⟩_q[ppBase, ppBase+2^w4)
                    ⊗ |acc0⟩_q[accBase+1, accBase+3*(f+1)+1 : 3)
                    ⊗ |res⟩_q[resBase+1, resBase+3*(W4*w4)+1 : 3)
                     ⊗ |0⟩_q[accBase, accBase+3*(f+1) : 3)
                     ⊗ |0⟩_q[accBase+2, accBase+3*(f+2)+2 : 3)
                     ⊗ |0⟩_q[cb, cb + W4*(2*(2^w4 - w4) + 5*f + 2^(w4 // 2) + 2^(w4 - w4 // 2) - w4))) }}
    ensures      {{ Σ z < 2^dim . Σ res < 2^(ell+1) . Σ acc0 < trunc .
                    α(z + 2^dim*(res + 2^(ell+1)*acc0)) * (
                    |z⟩_q[0, cb)
                    ⊗ |z >> (cb + W4*(2*(2^w4 - w4) + 5*f + 2^(w4 // 2) + 2^(w4 - w4 // 2) - w4))⟩_q[cb + W4*(2*(2^w4 - w4) + 5*f + 2^(w4 // 2) + 2^(w4 - w4 // 2) - w4), dim)
                    ⊗ |(acc0 + (Σ j < W4 . lookup4Val(w4, i, j, (res >> j*w4) % 2^w4))) % trunc⟩_q[accBase+1, accBase+3*(f+1)+1 : 3)
                    ⊗ |res⟩_q[resBase+1, resBase+3*(W4*w4)+1 : 3)
                    ⊗ |0⟩_q[addrBase, addrBase+w4)
                    ⊗ |0⟩_q[ppBase, ppBase+2^w4)
                     ⊗ |0⟩_q[accBase, accBase+3*(f+1) : 3)
                     ⊗ |0⟩_q[accBase+2, accBase+3*(f+2)+2 : 3)) }}
    outcomes     none
    resource     { toffoli:  toffL4(w4, W4, f),
                   t:        7*toffL4(w4, W4, f),
                   rot:      0,
                   meas:     measL4(w4, W4, f),
                   clifford: cliffL4(w4, W4, f, trunc, tOff) }

gadget gUnloop3Step[q: top,
                    c: cb + 2*(2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 - 1) + 5*ell + 5 + 2*(2^w3 - w3 - 1)]
                   (w3, ell, modulus, dlogBase, resBase, addrBase,
                    ppBase, helpBase, j, k, tOff, rOff, cb):
  cxCascade(w3, 3, dlogBase+3*(j*w3)+1, 1, addrBase+w3) @ id()
  cxCascade(w3, 3, resBase+3*(k*w3)+1, 1, addrBase) @ id()
  lookupPP(2*w3, ell+1, addrBase, ppBase, helpBase, 3, tOff, cb) @ id()
  gidneyModAddSub(ell, cb + 2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 - 1) @ shift(helpBase)
  mxDescending(ell+1, helpBase, 3, cb + 2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 - 1 + ell) @ id()
  CX(helpBase+3*ell+1, helpBase+3*(ell+1)+2)
  conditionalAddPNC(ell+1, 3*(ell+1)+2, modulus,
                    cb + 2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 - 1 + 2*ell + 1) @ shift(helpBase)
  H(helpBase+3*(ell+1)+2)
  measure (helpBase+3*(ell+1)+2) ↦ c[cb + 2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 - 1 + 2*ell + 1 + ell]
  when c[cb + 2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 - 1 + 2*ell + 1 + ell]:
    X(helpBase+3*(ell+1)+2)

  when c[cb + 2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 - 1 + 2*ell + 1 + ell]:
    X(helpBase + 3*(ell+1) + 2)
  when c[cb + rOff]:
    X(helpBase + 3*(ell+1) + 2)
  measure (helpBase + 3*(ell+1) + 2) ↦ c[cb + 2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 - 1 + 2*ell + 1 + ell + 1]
  when c[cb + 2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 - 1 + 2*ell + 1 + ell + 1]:
    X(helpBase + 3*(ell+1) + 2)
  when c[cb + 2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 - 1 + 2*ell + 1 + ell + 1]:
    lookupPP(2*w3, ell+1, addrBase, ppBase, helpBase, 3, tOff + 2^(2*w3),
             cb + 2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 - 1 + 3*ell + 3) @ id()
    for 0 ≤ b < ell+1:
      X(helpBase+3*b+1)
    gidneyCompare(ell+1, cb + 2*(2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 - 1) + 3*ell + 3) @ shift(helpBase)
    for 0 ≤ b < ell+1:
      X(helpBase+3*b+1)
    mxDescending(ell+1, helpBase, 3, cb + 2*(2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 - 1) + 4*ell + 4) @ id()

  powerProduct(w3, addrBase, ppBase) @ id()
  powerProduct(w3, addrBase + w3, ppBase + 2^w3) @ id()
  for 0 ≤ mL < 2^w3:
    for 0 ≤ mH < 2^w3:
      when ⊕ i < ell+1 . (c[cb + 2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 - 1 + ell + i] ∧ (Tbar[tOff*4096 + i*2^w3 + mL] >> mH) % 2 = 1):
        CZ(ppBase + mL, ppBase + 2^w3 + mH)
  for 0 ≤ mL < 2^w3:
    for 0 ≤ mH < 2^w3:
      when ⊕ i < ell+1 . (c[cb + 2*(2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 - 1) + 4*ell + 4 + i] ∧ (Tbar[(tOff + 2^(2*w3))*4096 + i*2^w3 + mL] >> mH) % 2 = 1):
        CZ(ppBase + mL, ppBase + 2^w3 + mH)
  powerProductRelease(w3, addrBase, ppBase,
                      cb + 2*(2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 - 1) + 5*ell + 5) @ id()
  powerProductRelease(w3, addrBase + w3, ppBase + 2^w3,
                      cb + 2*(2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 - 1) + 5*ell + 5 + 2^w3 - w3 - 1) @ id()

  cxCascade(w3, 3, resBase+3*(k*w3)+1, 1, addrBase) @ id()
  cxCascade(w3, 3, dlogBase+3*(j*w3)+1, 1, addrBase+w3) @ id()

spec gUnloop3Step:
  ∀ m < 2 . ∀α .
    requires     2 ≤ ell ∧ 0 < w3 ∧ 2 ≤ modulus ∧ 2 ≤ j ∧ k < W3b
                 ∧ 2*(2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 - 1) + 5*ell + 5 + 2*(2^w3 - w3 - 1) ≤ rOff
                 ∧ dlogBase ≤ helpBase ∧ helpBase + 3*(ell+2) ≤ addrBase
                 ∧ addrBase + 2*w3 ≤ ppBase ∧ ppBase + 2^(2*w3) ≤ dim
                 ∧ cb + 2*(2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 - 1) + 5*ell + 5 + 2*(2^w3 - w3 - 1) ≤ recTop

                 ∧ ppBase + 2^(2*w3) ≤ top ∧ top ≤ cb

    assumes {{ (Σ z < 2^dim . (Σ x < 2^w3 . (Σ y < 2^w3 . (Σ acc < modulus . α(z + 2^dim*(x + 2^w3*(y + 2^w3*acc))) * (
      |z⟩_q[0, dim)
      ⊗ |x⟩_q[dlogBase+3*(j*w3)+1, dlogBase+3*((j+1)*w3)+1 : 3)

      ⊗ |0⟩_q[addrBase, addrBase+2*w3)
      ⊗ |0⟩_q[ppBase, ppBase+2^(2*w3))
      ⊗ |0⟩_q[helpBase, helpBase+3*(ell+1) : 3)
      ⊗ |acc⟩_q[helpBase+1, helpBase+3*(ell+1)+1 : 3)
      ⊗ |0⟩_q[helpBase+2, helpBase+3*(ell+1)+2 : 3)
      ⊗ |0⟩_q[helpBase+3*(ell+1)+2]
      ⊗ |0⟩_q[cb, cb + 2*(2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 - 1) + 5*ell + 5 + 2*(2^w3 - w3 - 1))
      ⊗ |m⟩_q[cb+rOff] ))))) }}
    ensures {{ (Σ z < 2^dim . (Σ x < 2^w3 . (Σ y < 2^w3 . (Σ acc < modulus . α(z + 2^dim*(x + 2^w3*(y + 2^w3*acc))) * (-1)^(m*bit((acc + lookupVal(2*w3, ell+1, tOff, y + 2^w3*x)) % 2^(ell+1), ell)) * (
      |z⟩_q[0, cb)
      ⊗ |z >> (cb + 2*(2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 - 1) + 5*ell + 5 + 2*(2^w3 - w3 - 1))⟩_q[cb + 2*(2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 - 1) + 5*ell + 5 + 2*(2^w3 - w3 - 1), dim)
      ⊗ |x⟩_q[dlogBase+3*(j*w3)+1, dlogBase+3*((j+1)*w3)+1 : 3)
      ⊗ |y⟩_q[resBase+3*(k*w3)+1, resBase+3*((k+1)*w3)+1 : 3)
      ⊗ |0⟩_q[addrBase, addrBase+2*w3)
      ⊗ |0⟩_q[ppBase, ppBase+2^(2*w3))
      ⊗ |0⟩_q[helpBase, helpBase+3*(ell+1) : 3)
      ⊗ |modAddBackVal(ell, modulus, (acc + lookupVal(2*w3, ell+1, tOff, y + 2^w3*x)) % 2^(ell+1))⟩_q[helpBase+1, helpBase+3*(ell+1)+1 : 3)
      ⊗ |0⟩_q[helpBase+2, helpBase+3*(ell+1)+2 : 3)
      ⊗ |0⟩_q[helpBase+3*(ell+1)+2]
      ⊗ |m⟩_q[cb+rOff] ))))) }}
    outcomes     none
    resource     { toffoli:  toffU3Step(w3, ell),
                   t:        7*toffU3Step(w3, ell),
                   rot:      0,
                   meas:     measU3Step(w3, ell),
                   clifford: cliffU3Step(w3, ell, modulus, tOff) }


gadget gUnloop3HalfA[q: top,

spec gUnloop3HalfA:
  ∀α .

                 ∧ (∀ k2 < W3b . modulus ≤ 2^ell ∧ (∀ addr < 2^(2*w3) . lookupVal(2*w3, ell+1, (tOff + 2*((W3a-1-u2)*(2*W3b) + W3b-1-k2)*2^(2*w3)) + 2^(2*w3), addr) < modulus ∧ lookupVal(2*w3, ell+1, (tOff + 2*((W3a-1-u2)*(2*W3b) + W3b-1-k2)*2^(2*w3)), addr) = (2^(ell+1) - (modulus - lookupVal(2*w3, ell+1, (tOff + 2*((W3a-1-u2)*(2*W3b) + W3b-1-k2)*2^(2*w3)) + 2^(2*w3), addr))) % 2^(ell+1)) ∧ (∀ cube < 2 . ∀ b < ell+1 . ∀ mL < 2^w3 . ∀ mH < 2^w3 . bit(Tbar[((tOff + 2*((W3a-1-u2)*(2*W3b) + W3b-1-k2)*2^(2*w3)) + cube*2^(2*w3))*4096 + b*2^w3 + mL], mH) = bit(Tanf[((tOff + 2*((W3a-1-u2)*(2*W3b) + W3b-1-k2)*2^(2*w3)) + cube*2^(2*w3)) + mL + 2^w3*mH], b)) ∧ modulus ≤ 2^ell ∧ (∀ addr < 2^(2*w3) . lookupVal(2*w3, ell+1, (tOff + 2*((W3a-1-u2)*(2*W3b) + W3b + W3b-1-k2)*2^(2*w3)) + 2^(2*w3), addr) < modulus ∧ lookupVal(2*w3, ell+1, (tOff + 2*((W3a-1-u2)*(2*W3b) + W3b + W3b-1-k2)*2^(2*w3)), addr) = (2^(ell+1) - (modulus - lookupVal(2*w3, ell+1, (tOff + 2*((W3a-1-u2)*(2*W3b) + W3b + W3b-1-k2)*2^(2*w3)) + 2^(2*w3), addr))) % 2^(ell+1)) ∧ (∀ cube < 2 . ∀ b < ell+1 . ∀ mL < 2^w3 . ∀ mH < 2^w3 . bit(Tbar[((tOff + 2*((W3a-1-u2)*(2*W3b) + W3b + W3b-1-k2)*2^(2*w3)) + cube*2^(2*w3))*4096 + b*2^w3 + mL], mH) = bit(Tanf[((tOff + 2*((W3a-1-u2)*(2*W3b) + W3b + W3b-1-k2)*2^(2*w3)) + cube*2^(2*w3)) + mL + 2^w3*mH], b)))
    assumes      {{ Σ z < 2^dim . (Σ x < 2^w3 . (Σ r < 2^(W3b*w3) . α(z + 2^dim*(x + 2^w3*r)) * (

                      ⊗ |r⟩_q[resBase+1, resBase+3*(W3b*w3)+1 : 3)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[addrBase, addrBase+2*w3)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[ppBase, ppBase+2^(2*w3))
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[helpBase, helpBase+3*(ell+1) : 3)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[helpBase+1, helpBase+3*(ell+1)+1 : 3)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[helpBase+2, helpBase+3*(ell+1)+2 : 3)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[helpBase+3*(ell+1)+2]
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[cb, cb + W3b*(2*(2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 - 1) + 5*ell + 5 + 2*(2^w3 - w3 - 1)))
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[recBase + (W3a-2)*W3b] ))) }}
    ensures      {{ Σ z < 2^dim . (Σ x < 2^w3 . (Σ r < 2^(W3b*w3) . α(z + 2^dim*(x + 2^w3*r)) * (
                      |z⟩_q[0, cb)
                      ⊗ |z >> (cb + W3b*(2*(2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 - 1) + 5*ell + 5 + 2*(2^w3 - w3 - 1)))⟩_q[cb + W3b*(2*(2^(2*w3) - 2*w3 - 1) + 5*ell + 5 + 2*(2^w3 - w3 - 1)), dim)
                      ⊗ |x⟩_q[dlogBase+3*((W3a-1-u2)*w3)+1, dlogBase+3*((W3a-u2)*w3)+1 : 3)
                      ⊗ |r⟩_q[resBase+1, resBase+3*(W3b*w3)+1 : 3)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[addrBase, addrBase+2*w3)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[ppBase, ppBase+2^(2*w3))
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[helpBase, helpBase+3*(ell+1) : 3)

gadget gUnloop3HalfB[q: top,

spec gUnloop3HalfB:

  ∀α .
    requires     0 < cStride ∧ 0 < tStride
                 ∧ (∀ i < n . cBase + cStride*i < dim ∧ tBase + tStride*i < dim)
                 ∧ (∀ i < n . ∀ j < n . cBase + cStride*i ≠ tBase + tStride*j)
    assumes      {{ Σ z < 2^dim . (Σ x < 2^(2*n) . α(z + 2^dim*x)
                      * ( |z⟩_q[0, dim)
                          ⊗ |x % 2^n⟩_q[cBase, cBase + cStride*n : cStride)
                          ⊗ |x >> n⟩_q[tBase, tBase + tStride*n : tStride) )) }}
    ensures      {{ Σ z < 2^dim . (Σ x < 2^(2*n) . α(z + 2^dim*x)
                      * ( |z⟩_q[0, dim)
                          ⊗ |x % 2^n⟩_q[cBase, cBase + cStride*n : cStride)
                          ⊗ |bitXor(n, x >> n, x % 2^n)⟩_q[tBase, tBase + tStride*n : tStride) )) }}
    outcomes     none
    resource     { toffoli:  0,
                   t:        0,
                   rot:      0,
                   meas:     0,
                   clifford: n,
                   ops:      n }

gadget tailAfterPrimes[q: top,
                       c: cb + W1*(2^w1 - w1 + 2*D - 2) + D
                             + W1*(2^(w1 // 2) + 2^(w1 - w1 // 2) - w1 - 2)](cb):
  gLoop1(W1, w1, m, D, expBase, dlogBase, addrBase, ppBase, P*primeStride, cb) @ id()
  for 0 ≤ b < D:
    measure (dlogBase + 1 + 3*b) ↦ c[cb + W1*(2^w1 - w1 + 2*D - 2) + b]
    when c[cb + W1*(2^w1 - w1 + 2*D - 2) + b]:
      X(dlogBase + 1 + 3*b)
  for 0 ≤ j < W1:
    cxCascade(min(w1, m - j*w1), 1, expBase+j*w1, 1, addrBase) @ id()
    powerProduct(w1 // 2, addrBase, ppBase) @ id()
    powerProduct(w1 - w1 // 2, addrBase + w1 // 2, ppBase + 2^(w1 // 2)) @ id()
    for 0 ≤ mL < 2^(w1 // 2):
      for 0 ≤ mH < 2^(w1 - w1 // 2):
        when ⊕ i < D . (c[cb + W1*(2^w1 - w1 + 2*D - 2) + i] ∧ (Tbar[j*2^w1*4096 + i*2^(w1 // 2) + mL] >> mH) % 2 = 1):
          CZ(ppBase + mL, ppBase + 2^(w1 // 2) + mH)
    powerProductRelease(w1 // 2, addrBase, ppBase,
                        cb + W1*(2^w1 - w1 + 2*D - 2) + D
                           + j*(2^(w1 // 2) + 2^(w1 - w1 // 2) - w1 - 2)) @ id()
    powerProductRelease(w1 - w1 // 2, addrBase + w1 // 2, ppBase + 2^(w1 // 2),
                        cb + W1*(2^w1 - w1 + 2*D - 2) + D
                           + j*(2^(w1 // 2) + 2^(w1 - w1 // 2) - w1 - 2)
                           + 2^(w1 // 2) - w1 // 2 - 1) @ id()
    cxCascade(min(w1, m - j*w1), 1, expBase+j*w1, 1, addrBase) @ id()

spec tailAfterPrimes:
  ∀α .
    requires     0 < w1 // 2 ∧ 0 < w1 - w1 // 2 ∧ 2 ≤ D ∧ 0 < W1
                 ∧ m ≤ W1*w1 ∧ W1*w1 < m + w1
                 ∧ expBase + m ≤ dlogBase ∧ dlogBase + 3*D ≤ addrBase
                 ∧ addrBase + w1 ≤ ppBase ∧ ppBase + 2^w1 ≤ dim
                 ∧ cb + W1*(2^w1 - w1 + 2*D - 2) + D
                      + W1*(2^(w1 // 2) + 2^(w1 - w1 // 2) - w1 - 2) ≤ recTop
                 ∧ ppBase + 2^w1 ≤ top ∧ top ≤ cb
                 ∧ recTop ≤ dim
                 ∧ offL1 = 0
                 ∧ (∀ j < W1 . ∀ addr < 2^w1 .
                      lookupVal(w1, D, P*primeStride + j*2^w1, addr)
                        = lookup1(P, mx, D, w1, P, j, addr))
                 ∧ (∀ y < 2^m . dlogAfter(P, y) < 2^D)
                 ∧ (∀ y < 2^m . dlogAfter(P+1, y) = 0)
    assumes      {{ Σ z < 2^dim . (Σ y < 2^m . α(z + 2^dim*y) * (
                      |z⟩_q[0, expBase)
                      ⊗ |y⟩_q[expBase, expBase+m)
                      ⊗ |z >> (expBase+m)⟩_q[expBase+m, dlogBase)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[dlogBase, dlogBase+3*D : 3)
                      ⊗ |dlogAfter(P, y)⟩_q[dlogBase+1, dlogBase+3*D+1 : 3)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[dlogBase+2, dlogBase+3*D+2 : 3)
                      ⊗ |z >> (dlogBase+3*D)⟩_q[dlogBase+3*D, addrBase)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[addrBase, addrBase+w1)
                      ⊗ |z >> (addrBase+w1)⟩_q[addrBase+w1, ppBase)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[ppBase, ppBase+2^w1)
                      ⊗ |z >> (ppBase+2^w1)⟩_q[ppBase+2^w1, cb)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[cb, cb + W1*(2^w1 - w1 + 2*D - 2) + D + W1*(2^(w1 // 2) + 2^(w1 - w1 // 2) - w1 - 2))
                      ⊗ |z >> (cb + W1*(2^w1 - w1 + 2*D - 2) + D + W1*(2^(w1 // 2) + 2^(w1 - w1 // 2) - w1 - 2))⟩_q[cb + W1*(2^w1 - w1 + 2*D - 2) + D + W1*(2^(w1 // 2) + 2^(w1 - w1 // 2) - w1 - 2), dim) )) }}
    ensures      {{ Σ z < 2^dim . (Σ y < 2^m . α(z + 2^dim*y) * (
                      |z⟩_q[0, expBase)
                      ⊗ |y⟩_q[expBase, expBase+m)
                      ⊗ |z >> (expBase+m)⟩_q[expBase+m, dlogBase)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[dlogBase, dlogBase+3*D : 3)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[dlogBase+1, dlogBase+3*D+1 : 3)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[dlogBase+2, dlogBase+3*D+2 : 3)
                      ⊗ |z >> (dlogBase+3*D)⟩_q[dlogBase+3*D, addrBase)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[addrBase, addrBase+w1)
                      ⊗ |z >> (addrBase+w1)⟩_q[addrBase+w1, ppBase)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[ppBase, ppBase+2^w1)
                      ⊗ |z >> (ppBase+2^w1)⟩_q[ppBase+2^w1, cb)
                      ⊗ |z >> (cb + W1*(2^w1 - w1 + 2*D - 2) + D + W1*(2^(w1 // 2) + 2^(w1 - w1 // 2) - w1 - 2))⟩_q[cb + W1*(2^w1 - w1 + 2*D - 2) + D + W1*(2^(w1 // 2) + 2^(w1 - w1 // 2) - w1 - 2), dim) )) }}
    outcomes     none
    resource     { toffoli:  toffTail(P*primeStride),
                   t:        7*toffTail(P*primeStride),
                   rot:      0,
                   meas:     measTail(P*primeStride),
                   clifford: cliffTail(P*primeStride) }

gadget scatterBand[q: accBase + 3*maskBits + 2]():
  for 0 ≤ b < maskBits:
    H(accBase + 3*b + 1)

spec scatterBand:
  ∀α .
  requires       0 < maskBits
                 ∧ (∀ k < maskBits . accBase + 3*k + 1 < dim)
  assumes        {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z) * (|z⟩_q[0, dim)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[accBase+1, accBase + 3*maskBits + 1 : 3)) }}
  ensures        {{ Σ z < 2^dim . (Σ s < 2^maskBits . (α(z)/sqrt(2^maskBits)) * (|z⟩_q[0, dim)
                      ⊗ |s⟩_q[accBase+1, accBase + 3*maskBits + 1 : 3))) }}
  outcomes       none
  resource       { toffoli:  0,
                   t:        0,
                   rot:      0,
                   meas:     0,
                   clifford: maskBits,
                   depth:    1,
                   width:    maskBits,
                   ops:      maskBits,
                   qubits:   maskBits }

gadget powerProduct[q: ppBase + 2^k](k, addrBase, ppBase):
  X(ppBase)
  CX(addrBase, ppBase + 1)
  for 1 ≤ i < k:
    CX(addrBase + i, ppBase + 2^i)
    for 1 ≤ S < 2^i:
      CCX(ppBase + S, addrBase + i, ppBase + S + 2^i)

spec powerProduct:
  ∀α .
    requires  0 < k ∧ addrBase + k ≤ ppBase ∧ ppBase + 2^k ≤ dim
    assumes   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . (Σ a < 2^k . α(z + 2^dim*a) *
                   (|z⟩_q[0, dim) ⊗ |a⟩_q[addrBase, addrBase + k)
                    ⊗ |0⟩_q[ppBase, ppBase + 2^k))) }}
    ensures   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . (Σ a < 2^k . α(z + 2^dim*a) *
                   (|z⟩_q[0, dim) ⊗ |a⟩_q[addrBase, addrBase + k)
                    ⊗ |(Σ S < 2^k . ppSpec(k, a, S)*2^S)⟩_q[ppBase, ppBase + 2^k))) }}
    outcomes  none

gadget powerProductRelease[q: ppBase + 2^k, c: cb + 2^k - k - 1](k, addrBase, ppBase, cb):
  for 0 ≤ i < k:
    for 1 ≤ S < 2^(k - 1 - i):
      H(ppBase + S + 2^(k - 1 - i))
      measure (ppBase + S + 2^(k - 1 - i)) ↦ c[cb + (2^i - 1)*2^(k - i) - i + (S - 1)]
      when c[cb + (2^i - 1)*2^(k - i) - i + (S - 1)]:
        CZ(ppBase + S, addrBase + k - 1 - i)
        X(ppBase + S + 2^(k - 1 - i))
  for 0 ≤ i < k:
    CX(addrBase + i, ppBase + 2^i)
  X(ppBase)

spec powerProductRelease:
  ∀ keep < cb - (ppBase + 2^k) + 1 . ∀α .
    requires  addrBase + k ≤ ppBase ∧ ppBase + 2^k ≤ cb
              ∧ cb + (2^k - k - 1) ≤ dim
    assumes   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . (Σ a < 2^k . α(z + 2^dim*a) *
                   (|z⟩_q[0, ppBase + 2^k + keep)
                    ⊗ |z >> (cb + (2^k - k - 1))⟩_q[cb + (2^k - k - 1), dim)
                    ⊗ |a⟩_q[addrBase, addrBase + k)
                    ⊗ |(Σ S < 2^k . ppSpec(k, a, S)*2^S)⟩_q[ppBase, ppBase + 2^k)
                    ⊗ |0⟩_q[cb, cb + (2^k - k - 1)))) }}
    ensures   {{ Σ z < 2^dim . (Σ a < 2^k . α(z + 2^dim*a) *
                   (|z⟩_q[0, ppBase + 2^k + keep)
                    ⊗ |z >> (cb + (2^k - k - 1))⟩_q[cb + (2^k - k - 1), dim)
                    ⊗ |a⟩_q[addrBase, addrBase + k)
                    ⊗ |0⟩_q[ppBase, ppBase + 2^k))) }}
    outcomes  none

gadget accYSwapG[q: max(aBase + aStride*bits, yBase + yStride*bits)]
                (bits, aBase, aStride, yBase, yStride):
  cxCascade(bits, aStride, aBase, yStride, yBase) @ id()
  cxCascade(bits, yStride, yBase, aStride, aBase) @ id()
  cxCascade(bits, aStride, aBase, yStride, yBase) @ id()

spec accYSwapG:
  ∀α .
    requires 0 < aStride ∧ 0 < yStride
             ∧ (∀ i < bits . aBase + aStride*i < dim ∧ yBase + yStride*i < dim)
             ∧ (∀ i < bits . ∀ k < bits . aBase + aStride*i ≠ yBase + yStride*k)
    assumes {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z) * |z⟩_q[0, dim) }}
    ensures {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z)
                 * |swapRegS(z, aBase, aStride, yBase, yStride, bits)⟩_q[0, dim) }}
    outcomes none

spec prepConst:
  ∀ x < 2^W .
    requires 3*W ≤ dim
    assumes {{ |x⟩_q[0, 3*W : 3) }}
    ensures {{ |bitXor(W, x, d)⟩_q[0, 3*W : 3) }}
    outcomes none

spec prepMaskedP:
  ∀ b < 2 . ∀ x < 2^W .
    requires 3*W ≤ dim ∧ flag < dim ∧ (∀ i < W . flag ≠ 3*i)
    assumes {{ |b⟩_q[flag] ⊗ |x⟩_q[0, 3*W : 3) }}
    ensures {{ |b⟩_q[flag] ⊗ |bitXor(W, x, b*p)⟩_q[0, 3*W : 3) }}
    outcomes none

use FormalRV/Arithmetic/MeasuredAdder/measured_adder.prog

params  top

map shift(b)(i) = b + i

define wordRev(n, x)       = Σ i < n . bit(x, i) * 2^(n - 1 - i)
define cliffGrad(g, w, j)                  = 2*max(0, min(g, w - j) - 1) + cliffAdd(g)
define toffQft(w, g)                       = (w - 1)*(g - 1)
define measQft(w, g)                       = w + (w - 1)*(g - 1)
define cliffQft(w, g)                      = w + (Σ k < w - 1 . cliffGrad(g, w, k))
define qftReadPhase(w, g, r, x) = Σ u < w . bit(x, w-1-u)*(bit(r, u)*2^(g-1) + (Σ d < min(g, u+1) . (if d = 0 then 0 else bit(r, u-d)*2^(g-d-1))))

gadget gGradientPrep[q: gradBase + 3*g](g, gradBase):
  for 0 ≤ i < g:
    H(gradBase + 3*i + 1)
  for 0 ≤ i < g:
    Rz(gradBase + 3*i + 1, g - i - 1)

spec gGradientPrep:
  ∀α .
  requires       0 < g ∧ (∀ k < g . gradBase + 3*k + 1 < dim)
  assumes        {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z) * (|z⟩_q[0, dim)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[gradBase+1, gradBase + 3*g + 1 : 3)) }}
  ensures        {{ Σ z < 2^dim . (Σ k < 2^g . (α(z) * ω(-k, 2^g)/sqrt(2^g)) * (|z⟩_q[0, dim)
                      ⊗ |k⟩_q[gradBase+1, gradBase + 3*g + 1 : 3))) }}
  outcomes       none
  resource       { toffoli:  0,
                   t:        (if 3 ≤ g then 1 else 0),
                   rot:      max(0, g - 3),
                   meas:     0,
                   clifford: g + min(g, 2),
                   depth:    2,
                   width:    g,
                   ops:      2*g,
                   qubits:   g }

gadget gQftStage[q: top, c: mb + 1](base, k, mb):
  H(base+k)

  measure (base+k) ↦ c[mb]

spec gQftStage:
  ∀ r < 2 . ∀α .
    requires     base + k < dim ∧ mb < dim ∧ base + k ≠ mb ∧ top ≤ mb
    assumes      {{ Σ z < 2^dim . (Σ s < 2 . (Σ x < 2 . (α(z + 2^dim*s) * ω(s*x, 2)/sqrt(2)) * (
                      |z⟩_q[0, dim) ⊗ |x⟩_q[base+k] ⊗ |0⟩_q[mb]))) }}
    ensures      {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z + 2^dim*r) * (
                      |z⟩_q[0, dim) ⊗ |r⟩_q[base+k] ⊗ |r⟩_q[mb]) }}
    given c[mb-top, mb+1-top) = r
    outcomes     none
    resource     { toffoli:  0,
                   t:        0,
                   rot:      0,
                   meas:     1,
                   clifford: 1 }

gadget gQftMeasure[q: top, c: cb + w + (w-1)*(g-1)](base, w, gradBase, g, cb):
  gQftStage(base, w-1, cb) @ id()
  for 1 ≤ u < w:
    for 1 ≤ d < min(g, u+1):
      when c[cb + u - d]:
        CX(base + w - 1 - u, gradBase + 3*(g - d - 1))
    gidneyAddNoCarry(g, cb + w + (u-1)*(g-1)) @ shift(gradBase)
    for 1 ≤ d < min(g, u+1):
      when c[cb + u - d]:
        CX(base + w - 1 - u, gradBase + 3*(g - d - 1))
    gQftStage(base, w - 1 - u, cb + u) @ id()

spec gQftMeasure:
  ∀ r < 2^w . ∀α .
    requires     0 < w ∧ 2 ≤ g ∧ (gradBase + 3*g ≤ base ∨ (base + w ≤ gradBase ∧ gradBase + 3*g ≤ top))
                 ∧ base + w ≤ top ∧ top ≤ dim
                 ∧ cb + w + (w-1)*(g-1) ≤ dim ∧ top ≤ cb
    assumes      {{ Σ z < 2^dim . (Σ s < 2^w . (Σ x < 2^w . (Σ k < 2^g .
                      (α(z + 2^dim*s) * ω(-qftReadPhase(w, g, s, x) - k, 2^g)
                        /(sqrt(2^w)*sqrt(2^g))) * (
                        |z⟩_q[0, dim)
                        ⊗ |0⟩_q[gradBase, gradBase+3*g : 3)
                        ⊗ |k⟩_q[gradBase+1, gradBase+3*g+1 : 3)
                        ⊗ |0⟩_q[gradBase+2, gradBase+3*g+2 : 3)
                        ⊗ |x⟩_q[base, base+w)
                        ⊗ |0⟩_q[cb, cb+w+(w-1)*(g-1)) )))) }}
    ensures      {{ Σ z < 2^dim . (Σ k < 2^g . (α(z + 2^dim*r) * ω(-k, 2^g)/sqrt(2^g)) * (
                      |z⟩_q[0, cb)
                      ⊗ |z >> (cb+w+(w-1)*(g-1))⟩_q[cb+w+(w-1)*(g-1), dim)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[gradBase, gradBase+3*g : 3)
                      ⊗ |k⟩_q[gradBase+1, gradBase+3*g+1 : 3)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[gradBase+2, gradBase+3*g+2 : 3)
                      ⊗ |wordRev(w, r)⟩_q[base, base+w)
                      ⊗ |r⟩_q[cb, cb+w) )) }}
    given c[cb-top, cb+w-top) = r
    outcomes     none
    resource     { toffoli:  toffQft(w, g),
                   t:        7*toffQft(w, g),
                   rot:      0,
                   meas:     measQft(w, g),
                   clifford: cliffQft(w, g) }

map id()(i) = i

define bit(e, k)           = (e >> k) % 2
define cliffAdd(n)                         = 14*n - 15

define flip(x, k)         = if bit(x, k) = 1 then x - 2^k else x + 2^k
define xorInto(x, k, v)   = if v = 1 then flip(x, k) else x
define cxV(u, w, x)       = xorInto(x, w, bit(x, u))
define ccxV(u, v, w, x)   = xorInto(x, w, bit(x, u) * bit(x, v))
define vFirst(x)          = cxV(2, 4, cxV(2, 3, ccxV(0, 1, 2, x)))
define vInt(i, x)         = cxV(3*i+2, 3*(i+1)+1,
                              cxV(3*i+2, 3*(i+1),
                                cxV(3*(i-1)+2, 3*i+2, ccxV(3*i, 3*i+1, 3*i+2, x))))
define vLast(i, x)        = cxV(3*(i-1)+2, 3*i+2, ccxV(3*i, 3*i+1, 3*i+2, x))
define vFwd(0, x)         = vFirst(x)
define vFwd(m+1, x)       = vInt(m+1, vFwd(m, x))
define vCas(0, x)         = x
define vCas(m+1, x)       = cxV(3*m, 3*m+1, vCas(m, x))
define relV(w, x) = if bit(x, w) = 1 then x - 2^w else x
define vMInt(i, x) = relV(3*i+2, cxV(3*(i-1)+2, 3*i+2, cxV(3*i+2, 3*(i+1), cxV(3*i+2, 3*(i+1)+1, x))))
define vMFirst(x) = relV(2, cxV(2, 3, cxV(2, 4, x)))
define relCls(a, q0, q1, x) = bit(x, a) ⊕ (bit(x, q0)*(1 - bit(x, q1)))

gadget gidneyAddNoCarry[q: 3*n, c: cb + (n-1)](n, cb):
  gidneyForwardProp(n-1) @ id()
  finalCxCascade(n) @ id()
  for 0 ≤ k < n-1:
    if n-2-k ≠ 0:
      gidneyMeasInteriorRev(n-2-k, cb+k) @ id()
    else:
      gidneyMeasFirstRev(cb+k) @ id()

spec gidneyAddNoCarry:
  ∀ base < dim . ∀α .
    requires     2 ≤ n ∧ base + 3*n ≤ cb ∧ cb + (n-1) ≤ dim
    assumes      {{ Σ z < 2^dim . (Σ a < 2^n . (Σ b < 2^n . α(z + 2^dim*(a + 2^n*b)) * (
                      |z⟩_q[0, base)
                      ⊗ |a⟩_q[base+0, base+3*n+0 : 3) ⊗ |b⟩_q[base+1, base+3*n+1 : 3)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[base+2, base+3*n+2 : 3)
                      ⊗ |z >> (base+3*n)⟩_q[base+3*n, cb)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[cb, cb+(n-1))
                      ⊗ |z >> (cb+(n-1))⟩_q[cb+(n-1), dim) ))) }}
    ensures      {{ Σ z < 2^dim . (Σ a < 2^n . (Σ b < 2^n . α(z + 2^dim*(a + 2^n*b)) * (
                      |z⟩_q[0, base)
                      ⊗ |a⟩_q[base+0, base+3*n+0 : 3) ⊗ |(a+b) % 2^n⟩_q[base+1, base+3*n+1 : 3)
                      ⊗ |0⟩_q[base+2, base+3*n+2 : 3)
                      ⊗ |z >> (base+3*n)⟩_q[base+3*n, cb)
                      ⊗ |z >> (cb+(n-1))⟩_q[cb+(n-1), dim) ))) }}
    outcomes     none
    resource     { toffoli: n-1, t: 7*(n-1), rot: 0,
                   meas: n-1, clifford: cliffAdd(n) }

gadget gidneyForward[q: 3*n](n):
  gidneyForwardProp(n-1) @ id()
  gidneyLast(n-1) @ id()

spec gidneyForward:
  ∀ x < 2^(3*n) .
    requires   2 ≤ n  ∧  3*n ≤ dim

    assumes    {{ |x⟩_q[0, 3*n) }}

    ensures    {{ |vLast(n-1, vFwd(n-2, x))⟩_q[0, 3*n) }}

    outcomes   none

gadget gidneyForwardProp[q: 3*nSeg+2](nSeg):
  for 0 ≤ i < nSeg:
    if i ≠ 0:
      gidneyInterior(i) @ id()
    else:
      gidneyFirst() @ id()

spec gidneyForwardProp:
  ∀ base < dim . ∀α .
    requires   1 ≤ nSeg  ∧  base + 3*nSeg + 2 ≤ dim

    assumes    {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z) * |z⟩_q[0, dim) }}

    ensures    {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z) * |z % 2^base + 2^base * vFwd(nSeg-1, z >> base)⟩_q[0, dim) }}

    outcomes   none

gadget gidneyFirst[q: 5]():
  CCX(0, 1, 2)
  CX(2, 3)
  CX(2, 4)

spec gidneyFirst:
  ∀ base < dim . ∀α .
    requires   base + 5 ≤ dim

    assumes    {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z) * |z⟩_q[0, dim) }}

    ensures    {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z) * |z % 2^base + 2^base * vFirst(z >> base)⟩_q[0, dim) }}

    outcomes   none

gadget gidneyInterior[q: 3*i+5](i):
  CCX(3*i, 3*i+1, 3*i+2)
  CX(3*(i-1)+2, 3*i+2)
  CX(3*i+2, 3*(i+1))
  CX(3*i+2, 3*(i+1)+1)

spec gidneyInterior:
  ∀ base < dim . ∀α .
    requires   1 ≤ i  ∧  base + 3*i + 5 ≤ dim

    assumes    {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z) * |z⟩_q[0, dim) }}

    ensures    {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z) * |z % 2^base + 2^base * vInt(i, z >> base)⟩_q[0, dim) }}

    outcomes   none

gadget gidneyLast[q: 3*i+3](i):
  CCX(3*i, 3*i+1, 3*i+2)
  if i ≠ 0:
    CX(3*(i-1)+2, 3*i+2)

spec gidneyLast:
  ∀ x < 2^(3*i+3) .
    requires   1 ≤ i  ∧  3*i + 3 ≤ dim

    assumes    {{ |x⟩_q[0, 3*i+3) }}

    ensures    {{ |vLast(i, x)⟩_q[0, 3*i+3) }}

    outcomes   none

gadget finalCxCascade[q: 3*n](n):
  for 0 ≤ i < n:
    CX(3*i, 3*i+1)

spec finalCxCascade:
  ∀ base < dim . ∀α .
    requires   1 ≤ n  ∧  base + 3*n - 1 ≤ dim

    assumes    {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z) * |z⟩_q[0, dim) }}

    ensures    {{ Σ z < 2^dim . α(z) * |z % 2^base + 2^base * vCas(n, z >> base)⟩_q[0, dim) }}

    outcomes   none

gadget gidneyMeasInteriorRev[q: 3*i+5, c: cb+1](i, cb):
  CX(3*i+2, 3*(i+1)+1)
  CX(3*i+2, 3*(i+1))
  CX(3*(i-1)+2, 3*i+2)
  H(3*i+2)
  measure (3*i+2) ↦ c[cb]
  when c[cb]:
    X(3*i+1)
    CZ(3*i, 3*i+1)
    X(3*i+1)
    X(3*i+2)

spec gidneyMeasInteriorRev:
  ∀ base < dim . ∀ s < 2 . ∀α .
    requires 1 ≤ i ∧ base + 3*i+5 ≤ cb ∧ cb < dim
    assumes {{ Σ z < 2^dim . (α(z)*(1 - (relCls(3*i+2, 3*i, 3*i+1,
                                              cxV(3*(i-1)+2, 3*i+2, z >> base)) ⊕ s)))
                 * (|z⟩_q[0, dim) ⊗ |0⟩_q[cb]) }}
    ensures {{ Σ z < 2^dim . (α(z)*(1 - (relCls(3*i+2, 3*i, 3*i+1,
                                              cxV(3*(i-1)+2, 3*i+2, z >> base)) ⊕ s)))
                 * (|z % 2^base + 2^base * vMInt(i, z >> base)⟩_q[0, cb)
                    ⊗ |z >> (cb+1)⟩_q[cb+1, dim)) }}
    outcomes none

gadget gidneyMeasFirstRev[q: 5, c: cb+1](cb):
  CX(2, 4)
  CX(2, 3)
  H(2)
  measure (2) ↦ c[cb]
  when c[cb]:
    X(1)
    CZ(0, 1)
    X(1)
    X(2)

spec gidneyMeasFirstRev:
  ∀ base < dim . ∀ s < 2 . ∀α .
    requires base + 5 ≤ cb ∧ cb < dim
    assumes {{ Σ z < 2^dim . (α(z)*(1 - (relCls(2, 0, 1, z >> base) ⊕ s)))
                 * (|z⟩_q[0, dim) ⊗ |0⟩_q[cb]) }}
    ensures {{ Σ z < 2^dim . (α(z)*(1 - (relCls(2, 0, 1, z >> base) ⊕ s)))
                 * (|z % 2^base + 2^base * vMFirst(z >> base)⟩_q[0, cb)
                    ⊗ |z >> (cb+1)⟩_q[cb+1, dim)) }}
